title: Maddie Trim Detail T-Shirt-Burnt Orange
desc: Who doesn’t love a quality T-shirt for its undeniable versatility? This fitted cotton style delivers on that but we’ve elevated it beyond a basic by giving it a boho-inspired crochet trim. Choosing just one colour will be impossible. We recommend stocking up for summer. You won't regret it.

title: Maddie Trim Detail Vest-Ivory
desc: We have a vested (yes we did) interest in raising your joy levels. That's why we’ve taken a simple cotton vest and added a contrast colour trim. It's got a little stretch to keep its shape wash after wash. Choose from a variety of bright colours and pair with jeans or shorts.

title: Maddie Trim Detail T-Shirt-Vintage Rose
desc: Who doesn’t love a quality T-shirt for its undeniable versatility? This fitted cotton style delivers on that but we’ve elevated it beyond a basic by giving it a boho-inspired crochet trim. Choosing just one colour will be impossible. We recommend stocking up for summer. You won't regret it.

title: Elodie Jersey Maxi Dress-Green, Ornamental Floweret
desc: A jersey maxi dress is your secret weapon for looking put together but feeling comfortable. A deep V-neck and ruched waistband give our Elodie style a sculpted look while the choice of bright prints are holiday ready.

title: Satin Halterneck Top-Multi, Leopard Flow
desc: If you thought the ‘jeans and a nice top’ formula went out with the noughties, think again. This colourful satin halter with its raised neck band is the update you need (or swap denim for wide-leg trousers). If you’re feeling nostalgic add an upper arm cuff. Sienna circa 2002 would approve.

title: Catherine Broderie Dress-Navy Broderie
desc: Catherine is the kind of dress you can rely on to lift your spirits. It features as button front, halter neck and fit and flare shape. From navy broderie to bold green stripes and bitter chocolate there's an option for every mood. And who doesn't like options?

title: Ruffle Bodice Shirt Dress-Merida Red, Flowerbed Bloom
desc: There is something quite magical about this summery style. An elevated take on a classic cotton shirt dress, we’ve added eye-catching drama with layered shoulder ruffles, a built-in belt and a stunning print to finish. Just add espadrilles and sun-baked days.

title: Arabella Short Linen Dress-Safari Green
desc: You'll soon wonder where Arabella has been all your life. Crafted from a cotton linen blend fabric, this delightful dress features a short flippy skirt, cap sleeves and buckled belt. Take her as your plus one to all your summer events.

title: Short Sleeve Linen Shirt-Seamist Blue, Palm Paradise
desc: Could it be love at first shirt? The short sleeves, relaxed tailored fit and bold colours of this breezy style will transport you to a holiday romance state-of-mind wherever you are. Did we mention it's made from pure linen? Pair with our matching trousers as an easy co-ord.

title: Tape Lace T-shirt-Forget Me Not Blue
desc: It's a T-shirt, but not as you know it. To elevate this top from a wardrobe basic to a compliment magnet, we’ve added volume to the elbow-length sleeves and subtle lace motifs. Tuck it into jeans at home and roll it up into your suitcase to pair with shorts and swishy skirts on holiday.

title: Salisbury Puff Sleeve Jacket-Multi, Embroidery
desc: The beauty of our Salisbury jacket lies in its gently puffed sleeves, fabric covered buttons and glorious prints. Wear it to dress up jeans or pair it with the matching linen trousers for instant day-at-the-races energy.

title: Tara Cutwork Linen Tee-Ashleigh Blue
desc: A lightweight pure linen T-shirt elevated with an intricate embroidered lace shoulder design. It goes with everything and will keep you feeling cool on the hottest days. Wear it to work, weekend brunches or evening drinks, you choose.

title: Naomi Short Sleeve Dress-Pomegranate, Tigers Paradise
desc: Our Naomi short sleeve dress is that comfortable wear-anywhere style you’ll reach for time and again, especially now summer is finally here. From leopard print to polka dots we have lots of options to choose from. Add a belt and ballet pumps on office days.

title: Pleat Sleeve Lace T-shirt-Ivory
desc: Celebrate the arrival of short sleeve season (okay we made that up) with gathers and lace. This elegant top will work as hard for you in the office as it will at summer events. Let it elevate your favourite jeans on other days. Choose from ivory or navy to suit your mood.

title: Rosa Double Cloth Jumpsuit-Olive
desc: Rosa will send compliments your way with every wear. This simple cotton style is spun from breathable double cloth with a self-tie belt and wide-leg silhouette. It’ll roll-up easily in your suitcase without creasing. Add sandals and a bag to meet day or night demands.

title: Camille Embroidered Cotton Top-Ivory Broderie
desc: Now the sun is shining (most of the time) embrace this featherlight cotton top as the epitome of wardrobe optimism. We’ve crafted it with delicate buttons, puff sleeves and pretty frills. Choose from different colours and designs with broderie and embroidered details you’ll love.

title: Maddie Trim Detail T-Shirt-Navy
desc: Who doesn’t love a quality T-shirt for its undeniable versatility? This fitted cotton style delivers on that but we’ve elevated it beyond a basic by giving it a boho-inspired crochet trim. Choosing just one colour will be impossible. We recommend stocking up for summer. You won't regret it.

title: Regent Wide Leg Pants-Hunter Green, Orchid Canopy
desc: Want to wow fellow party guests in a wearable garden of dreams? These pleated wide-leg palazzo pants were created in collaboration with British artist Sarah Gordon, who has carefully hand-painted the floral print just for us. It's part of a beautiful, limited-edition edit. Yes, there's more.

Equipped with hand, stow, and tool pockets.

The strong midweight fabric is a reverse-sateen weave, smooth on the inside for easy layering. Sturdy buttons secure the front, chest-pocket flaps, and adjustable cuffs. Straight hem for untucked wear. Spread collar.

The four front cargo pockets are protected by snapped flaps, and a slotted utility pocket is layered on the left chest. The front and adjustable cuffs secure with durable buttons. title: PALAMPORE PATCHWORK OVERCOAT
desc: Our Palampore Patchwork Overcoat is made from handloom linen in an ecru, beige and black palette. The patchworked body is hand embroidered creating Chintz motifs, drawing from 17th century Palampore textile motifs. The coat is finished with a cotton lining and horn button closures. Designed to fit true to size.

title: KANTHA EMBROIDERY BLAZER
desc: Patchwork of handwoven wool and linen wool charcoal textiles. Embellished with a contrast kantha stitch. Finished with a silk lining and horn button closures. Designed to fit true to size.

title: ALMORA JACKET
desc: Woven in Almora, on Jacquard Handlooms in Merino Wool. Naturally Dyed by Avani Collective in Uttarakhand. Finished with horn button closures. Vintage coach jacket reference. Hand Embroidered in Lucknow with Zardozi Threadwork. Bringing this piece back for the first time since FW24. Designed to fit true to size, but the bottom is elasticated, so maybe size up.

title: VANKAR JACKET
desc: Cut from a handloom wool and linen blend in blue. The borders are hand embroidered by artisans in Kutch specializing in a Rabari technique, using a fine ecru cotton thread that contrasts against the base fabric. Finished with a Riri zip closure and small horn button detailing. The jacket has a pleat in the back, inspired by the spinners in Kutch and the stress on their clothes at the back seam. Designed to fit true to size, Elasticated Bottom. Model is 6'1 and wears a Medium.

title: VANKAR JACKET
desc: Cut from a handloom wool and linen blend in blue. The borders are hand embroidered by artisans in Kutch specializing in a Rabari technique, using a fine ecru cotton thread that contrasts against the base fabric. Finished with a Riri zip closure and small horn button detailing. The jacket has a pleat in the back, inspired by the spinners in Kutch and the stress on their clothes at the back seam. Designed to fit true to size, Elasticated Bottom. Model is 6'1 and wears a Medium.

title: JODHPUR JACKET
desc: Made from a naturally dyed handwoven denim in charcoal. The surface is hand-embroidered using our signature technique: red and green ripped up silk scarves kantha embroidered onto the denim fabric creating an abstract raised character. Finished with a cotton lining and horn button closures. Designed to fit true to size.

title: HARRINGTON JACKET
desc: You go hiking in all your Arcteryx and are somehow still freezing and yet the comfiest guy there is the local sherpa in a woolen stole. How do you translate that comfort into something contemporary enough for your day to day? Answer, our Merino Harrington. Made from brushed handwoven merino wool in black, with a soft bouncy hand. We developed this textile with weavers in Himachal. The Harrington finished with a Riri zip closure and horn button detailing at the band collar and oversized flap pockets. Designed to fit true to size.

title: PAISLEY KAZA JACKET
desc: Named after the place the fabric is made, Kaza, on the border of India and Tibet, in Kinnaur, Himachal. We developed a brushed handwoven merino wool in black, with a soft, textured hand. The fabric is embellished with contrast paisley motifs. Finished with a fine cotton piping detail along the seams. Complete with horn button closures. Designed to fit true to size.

title: HAND EMBROIDERED BLAZER
desc: Made from handloom wool, naturally dyed in black. The surface is hand embroidered with mismatched motifs using gold and red cotton thread and beads. Finished with a hand block printed Bemberg lining and horn button closures. Designed to fit true to size.

title: DOSHI OVERCOAT
desc: Our Suede Lapel Doshi Overcoat is made from handloom wool in brown tones, with a brushed texture. Finished with a contrast suede lapel in dark brown, a Block Printed Bemberg lining and horn button closure. Designed to fit true to size.

title: PINSTRIPE SHIRT
desc: Made from handwoven cotton in brown, woven with fine black micro stripes running through the fabric. The handloom weave gives it a soft, textured hand feel with the slight irregularity typical of hand-woven cloth. Naturally dyed and then finished with small horn button closures. Model is 6'1 and wears a Medium. Designed to fit true to size.

title: BHUTIA SHIRT
desc: Our Bhutia Shirt takes cues from vintage football training tops, reworked through traditional craft. This one is cut from a handwoven cotton-silk blend developed in Madhya Pradesh. Subtle gold check on faded indigo tones. Designed with a relaxed, easy silhouette. Size Up preferably. Model is 6'1 and wears a Large.

title: HIGH TWIST SHIRT
desc: Made from a handwoven high twist cotton in ecru. The high twist yarn gives the fabric a fine, slightly crisp texture and a subtle sheen, while the handloom process leaves it with a natural, irregular character that sets it apart from mill-woven cloth. Finished with shell button closures. Designed to fit true to size.

title: INDIGO CHECK SHIRT
desc: Made from handwoven cotton in a deep indigo and gold window check. The fabric is woven by hand on traditional looms, a slower process that leaves it with a natural texture and the subtle irregularities characteristic of handloom cloth, giving it a soft, textured hand feel. Finished with small mother of pearl hand carved buttons. Designed to fit true to size.

title: INDIGO ZARI CHECK SHIRT
desc: Made from handwoven cotton in an indigo and gold window check. The fabric is woven by hand on traditional looms, a slower process that leaves it with a natural texture and the subtle irregularities characteristic of handloom cloth. Finished with small horn button closures. Model is 6'1 and wears a Medium. Designed to fit true to size.

title: CHIKANKARI TEE
desc: We approached this by re-contextualizing traditional Chikankari techniques onto jersey. It changes how the embroidery sits, making it feel a bit more grounded and everyday. The paisley is placed on the pocket and back, intentionally subtle. It’s something you notice over time rather than immediately. Made in 100% organic cotton jersey, 220 GSM. Size one up for best fit.

title: BHUTIA SHIRT
desc: Our Bhutia Shirt takes cues from vintage football training tops, reworked through traditional craft. This one is cut from a handwoven cotton-silk blend developed in Bihar, offering a soft, fluid drape with a lightweight feel. The textile is detailed with Ajrakh printing using natural dyes, a traditional technique practiced by artisans in Gujarat, creating a layered interplay of purple, red and pearl tones. The surface is further enriched with hand embroidery, incorporating scrap red elements that introduce subtle contrast and texture across the garment. Designed with a relaxed, easy silhouette

title: LINEN STRIPE SHIRT
desc: Horn Button With Hidden Placket Handwoven Fabric 100% Linen Breezy and Boxy Fit

title: BHUTIA SHIRT
desc: Our Bhutia Shirt takes cues from vintage football training tops, reworked through traditional craft. It is cut in a cropped silhouette from a lightweight handwoven cotton fabric with a soft, fluid drape. The textile is block printed in Bagru, while a contrast Tussar silk collar and stripe detail introduce a subtle shift in texture. Designed with a cropped fit. Size up for a more relaxed fit.

title: BLOCK PRINT SHIRT
desc: Our Block Print Shirt is made from handwoven cotton printed in Bagru using traditional wooden blocks and natural dyes. The deep burgundy ground is layered with scattered gold motifs, giving the surface a rhythm that reflects the human hand behind the process. The shirt is finished with natural horn buttons. Designed to fit true to size.

title: PENROSE CARDIGAN -- SPRUCE
desc: The Penrose Cardigan is a ‘90s-inspired cable knit, crafted from a cozy alpaca-wool blend. Designed with a classic crew neckline and fitted raglan sleeves, it’s finished with pearl shank buttons and ribbed trims.

title: IONA SHORT -- SEA SALT ET NOIR
desc: In buttery silk satin, the Iona Short is an effortless pull-on style, featuring a high waist trimmed with elastic scallop detailing and intricate floral lace at the hems.

title: NIKA DRESS -- SUNRISE
desc: Our very first hand-crocheted treasure for littles, the DÔEN Heirloom Nika Dress draws inspiration from children’s knit dresses from the 1940s. With a high neckline, shift silhouette, and a skirt that falls to just above the knee, it’s detailed with floral crochet motifs and a scallop edged hem. Crafted from 100% mercerized Pima cotton, each dress is skillfully hand-crocheted by our artisans in Peru, with each one taking several days to complete. Because each dress is handmade, no two are exactly alike.

title: GLENNE PANT -- SALT
desc: Reimagined for warmer days in a lightweight, organic cotton-linen twill, the DÔEN Heirloom Glenne Pant takes cues from ‘60s sailor pants. It features a high waist, a structured wide-leg, and welt pockets at the front, plus a single welt pocket at the back. The waistband is adorned with two fixed shell buttons, plus additional shell buttons that fasten at both sides. Our co-founder Katherine loves wearing with the ribbed Auguste or Ilaria Tops.

title: NOELLE SHORT -- PEARL
desc: Hand-crocheted in Peru, the DÔEN Heirloom Noelle Short draws inspiration from the mini shorts of the late 1960s folk music scene. Featuring an allover crochet pointelle design, the Noelle is finished with an adjustable drawstring at the waist for an easy fit. Crafted from 100% mercerized Pima cotton, each short is skillfully hand-crocheted by our artisans in Peru, with each one taking several days to complete. Because each short is handmade, no two are exactly alike.

title: PARTRIDGE SKIRT -- CRAWFORD CHECK
desc: Tailored in our Crawford Check wool and fully lined in viscose twill, the DÔEN Heirloom Partridge Skirt is a ‘60s-inspired mini with a high waist and an A-line cut, finished with structured pleating and three faux horn buttons at the side, plus an internal button for the perfect fit.

title: HENRIETTA DRESS -- BLACK
desc: Rendered in a lightweight ramie, the Henrietta is a sleeveless button-front mini dress. The plunging V-neckline is framed by a cascading lace-trimmed ruffle that extends down the bodice and along the skirt’s hem. Pintucks lend texture to the relaxed bodice, which can be cinched at the back with a waist tie. A line of hidden starburst buttons extends down the front.

title: SOLINA TOP -- SALT
desc: The Solina Top is crafted from lightweight ramie, featuring a breezy silhouette, short puffed sleeves, and a scoop neckline with an adjustable tie and playful keyhole detail.

title: LITTLE PATIENCE DRESS -- SALT
desc: A charming take on our Patience Dress, the Little Patience is crafted from soft, lightweight organic cotton poplin. Ladder trim and lace adorn the neckline and bodice, while Edwardian-inspired details complete the yoke and floral eyelet hem. The square neckline is finished with a grosgrain ribbon.

title: VIVETTE DRESS -- MAGENTA
desc: An extra-special dress for little ones, the Vivette is crafted from buttery silk satin and finished with delicate lace trims at the neckline and hem, along with floral lace appliqués at the center bodice. A high neckline fastens at the back with two petite buttons.

title: TIA TOP -- SALT
desc: Cut from crisp organic cotton shirting and adorned with allover floral eyelet embroidery, the Tia Top is our take on a classic cropped tank. Delicate pintucks and mother-of-pearl buttons at the center back add a refined touch, while thin, flat grosgrain elastic straps can be removed for a strapless silhouette.

title: LITTLE DANSES DRESS -- ROSE PETIT BOUQUET DE CHAMONIX
desc: The Little Danses is a darling dress crafted from soft, midweight organic cotton voile. The round neckline is generously trimmed with grosgrain ribbons and scalloped lace that call back to the petite lace detailing at the arm openings and hem.

title: JULIA DRESS -- ROSE PETIT BOUQUET DE CHAMONIX
desc: Crafted from soft midweight organic cotton voile and rendered in our Petit Bouquet de Chamonix print, the Julia Dress features a scoop neckline and short puffed sleeves, with a breezy skirt that falls to just above the knee. Contrast piping trims the neckline and cuffs, and a petite fixed bow adorns the center front.

title: PATIENCE DRESS -- SALT
desc: With a simple ’60s-inspired popover silhouette, the Patience Dress is crafted from soft, lightweight organic cotton poplin. Ladder trim and lace adorn the neckline and bodice, while Edwardian-inspired details complete the yoke and floral eyelet hem. The square neckline is finished with a grosgrain ribbon.

title: TRAVELER TOP -- VERT PETIT BOUQUET DE CHAMONIX
desc: Our beloved Traveler Top returns, now rendered in soft, midweight organic cotton voile in our Petit Bouquet de Chamonix print. Featuring a slightly cropped silhouette, mother-of-pearl buttons, and a scoop neckline with a grosgrain ribbon tie, it’s finished with picot edges and ladder trim at the neckline, sleeve openings, and hemline.

title: FREDERICA TOP -- BLANC PRAIRIE ROSE
desc: Rendered in soft, lightweight organic cotton voile, the Frederica Top features a breezy silhouette. The round neckline and short puffed sleeves are adorned with scalloped lace. Alternating pintuck clusters, lace, and delicate floral embroidery decorate the front. Leave it loose, or tuck it into your favorite pair of high-waisted jeans.

title: TOULOUSE TOP -- DEEP AQUAMARINE
desc: A silk satin interpretation of our beloved Traveler, the Toulouse Top draws inspiration from Regency-era corset covers. The neckline is finished with embroidered eyelet trim threaded with a petite functional ribbon that ties into a bow. Hidden buttons run down the front, while delicate floral and dot embroidery and lace trim grace the hemline.

title: ILLIANA DRESS -- BLANC PRAIRIE ROSE
desc: An update to our beloved Ischia, the Iliana Dress is crafted from soft organic cotton and draws inspiration from Edwardian dressing gowns. A full, tiered skirt flutters from the waist, gathered with elastic smocking for an easy pull-on fit. A generous ruffle frames the neckline, finished with light blue contrast grosgrain ribbon and scalloped lace trim.

title: GIULIETTA SKIRT -- GATEAU
desc: Crafted from buttery silk satin, the Giulietta is a bias-cut mini skirt, finished with delicate scalloped elastic at the high waist and romantic floral lace along the hem.

title: ELOWETTE SKIRT -- DEEP AQUAMARINE
desc: The Elowette Skirt is a bias-cut, midi-length skirt in buttery silk satin. Finished with delicate scalloped elastic at the high waist and floral lace along the hem, it features a petite lace patch at the waist for a pretty finishing touch.

title: LITTLE FREDERICA TOP -- SALT
desc: A darling version of our Frederica Top sized for little ones, the Little Frederica features an easy popover silhouette, round neckline, and short puffed sleeves adorned with scalloped lace. Rendered in soft, lightweight cotton voile, this little treasure is decorated with alternating pintuck clusters, lace, and delicate floral embroidery.

title: MARCIETTE SKIRT -- EARTHA PAISLEY
desc: Crafted from a midweight organic cotton voile, the Marciette Skirt features a high waist and a full, ankle-grazing skirt with an invisible side zipper for the perfect fit.

title: JUNE TOP -- EARTHA PAISLEY
desc: Crafted from soft, midweight cotton voile in our vintage block-print-inspired Eartha Paisley, the June Top is a short-sleeved take on our beloved Jane Blouse. It features a gathered scoop neckline, full raglan sleeves, and a relaxed, breezy cut. A line of mother-of-pearl buttons extends down the center front. Wear it loose, or tuck it into your favorite high-waisted jeans or shorts.

title: LAURENT JEAN -- SELUNE WASH
desc: Crafted from 100% regenerative cotton denim, the Laurent Jean is a straight-legged silhouette inspired by vintage slim-fit jeans from the ‘70s. A favorite of our co-founders Margaret and Katherine, the Laurent features a high rise, an elongated straight leg, and a button-and-zipper closure, plus pointed back pockets and classic front pockets.

title: PETIT GARDENIA CASHMERE CARDIGAN -- CLEAR SKY
desc: In the softest, 100% certified cashmere, our Petit Gardenia Cardigan is perfectly sized for little ones, with sweet hand-embroidered florals for a charming touch. It features a classic crew neckline and raglan full-length sleeves, finished with ribbed details at the collar, hem, and cuffs. A line of buttons extends down the front. Made with SFA-certified cashmere, supporting animal welfare, environmental stewardship, and herder livelihoods through verified traceable supply chains.

title: NERA TOP -- FLEURS DE BORDEAUX
desc: Crafted from crisp organic cotton poplin, the Nera Top returns in our Fleurs de Bordeaux print, inspired by an English Regency-era block print. Short puffed sleeves and a scoop neckline are threaded with grosgrain ribbon, while floral eyelet stitching and a line of starburst buttons adorn the front.

title: MARIE SKIRT -- BLANC PRAIRIE ROSE
desc: The Marie Skirt is crafted from soft organic cotton voile patterned with our antique-inspired Prairie Rose floral print. Tiered at the hips, it’s detailed with pintucks along the ankle-grazing hem. An invisible side-seam zipper with a hook-and-eye closure ensures the perfect fit.

title: FLORIETTE TOP -- PEACH SORBET
desc: Crafted from a radiant jacquard, the Floriette Top nods to 1940s bed jacket styles. Generous ruffles at the neckline, hem, and flutter sleeves create flowy movement, while three delicate buttons at the top and a petite self tie at the center provide closure. Made with 38% Lenzing™ ECOVERO™, which comes from sustainably-managed forests and has lower water and emissions impacts than traditional viscose.

title: FIORENZA SKIRT -- SALT
desc: Inspired by 1970s wrap skirt styles, the Fiorenza Skirt is an exuberant confection of abundant ruffles, crafted from a shimmering jacquard. The waist ties into a bow at the hip and is secured by an adjustable petite interior button. Made with 38% Lenzing™ ECOVERO™, which comes from sustainably-managed forests and has lower water and emissions impacts than traditional viscose.

title: LISA PANT -- SALT
desc: Tailored in structured cotton twill, the Lisa Pant features an ultra-high waist and a wide-leg silhouette with pleats for ease. It’s finished with side seam pockets, two welt pockets at the back, and a faux horn button and hidden side-zip closure.

title: OLETA TOP -- SALT FLOCK DOT
desc: Crafted from soft organic cotton voile patterned with pale blue flockdots, the Oleta Top is graced with vintage details. It features clustered pintucks and a Peter Pan collar framed with intricate Battenberg lace and pleated organza tulle, with a line of mother-of-pearl buttons extending down the center front.

title: MARCELINE SKIRT -- SALERNO STRIPE
desc: Inspired by our best-selling Sebastiane Skirt, the Marceline is designed with a full, tiered silhouette finished with a row of mother-of-pearl buttons down the center front. Cut from washed organic cotton for a lived-in softness, it’s rendered in our nostalgic yarn-dyed Salerno Stripe.

title: LILIANE DRESS -- SUNSHINE PRAIRIE ROSE
desc: Rendered in our delicate Prairie Rose floral, the Liliane Dress is crafted from soft, lightweight organic cotton voile with pretty inset lace and ladder trims throughout. Princess seams gently shape the midi-length skirt, while delicate snaps and mother-of-pearl buttons fasten at the nape of the neck.

title: LAVONA PANT -- POWDER
desc: Cut from crisp organic cotton poplin, the Lavona Pant is an effortless pull-on silhouette with a mid-rise, elasticized waist. Horizontal pintucks and lace trims at the hems nod to antique Edwardian detailing.

title: LAVON FRINGE PANT -- BLEU TAORMINA PAISLEY
desc: Cut from buttery silk-viscose twill patterned with our Taormina Paisley, the Lavon Fringe Pant is an effortless pull-on style. Placed borders and silky fringe trim the hems, while an elasticated waist ensures an easy, comfortable fit.

title: ISCHIA DRESS -- SALT FLOCK DOT
desc: A Favorite Character beloved for its easy-going romance, the Ischia Dress is reimagined in a soft organic cotton voile with allover flock dots. It features double-puffed sleeves, a scoop neckline, and a smocked bodice with two adjustable ties. Petite ruffles trim the neckline and sleeve cuffs, while the fully-lined ankle-grazing skirt is finished with shirring and princess seams for graceful movement.

title: ELOWETTE SKIRT -- PEACH SORBET
desc: Cut on the bias from buttery silk satin, the Elowette Skirt is a midi-length silhouette finished with delicate scalloped elastic at the high waist and floral lace along the hem.

title: VIVIANE TOP -- PEACH SORBET
desc: Made from buttery silk satin, the Viviane Top features a relaxed, boxy silhouette adorned with intricate floral lace at the high bateau neckline, bodice, and hem.

title: MELIE DRESS -- BLACK
desc: Crafted from crisp organic cotton poplin, the Melie Dress features a high bateau neckline and a stretchy smocked bodice. A third gathered panel finishes just below the hips, flaring out into an easy, ankle-grazing skirt.

title: ASHLYNN DRESS -- SUNSHINE PRAIRIE ROSE
desc: Made from soft, lightweight organic cotton voile in our Prairie Rose floral, the Ashlynn Dress draws inspiration from our fan-favorite Ischia with its romantic smocking and flowy silhouette. This midi-length style features short puffed sleeves, a stretchy smocked bodice, and adjustable ties at the scoop neckline and waist. Petite ruffles at the neckline and sleeve cuffs add a charming vintage touch.

title: LITTLE PASCUAL JACKET -- STRAW
desc: The Little Pascual Jacket is our beloved barn jacket, perfectly fitted for little ones. Crafted from garment-dyed cotton, the Little Pascual features an easy fit with a contrast corduroy collar and inner cuff detail. Corozo buttons line the front, while two hip pockets and a chest pocket are perfect for tucking tiny treasures.

title: MONICA SWEATER -- PARFAIT
desc: In a soft, slightly sheer blend of superfine alpaca and merino wool, the ‘60s-inspired Monica Sweater features a delicate allover pointelle design, short sleeves, and ribbed detailing at the cuffs, neckline, and hem. Hitting slightly below the true waist, it can be layered or worn on its own.

title: QUINETTE DRESS -- IVORY LANTANA FLORAL
desc: The Quinette Dress is a new take on our beloved Quinn Dress, reimagined with a soft sweetheart neckline and delicate cap sleeves. Cut from soft organic cotton voile in our Lantana Floral, it features a flattering shirred bodice with fixed smocking at the waist that extends into a midi-length skirt.

title: CLAIRETTE TOP -- SALT
desc: Rendered in soft, lightweight organic cotton voile, the Clairette Top is detailed with alternating panels of inset lace, embroidered eyelets and delicate ladder trim. Short puffed sleeves are finished with lace edging, while the plunging V-neckline is framed with a cascading, lace-trimmed ruffle that extends down the bodice. A row of mother-of-pearl buttons fastens at the front.

title: JULIENNE TOP -- PEACH SORBET MARSEILLE EMBROIDERY
desc: The Julienne is an iteration of one of our earliest styles, the Jane Blouse. Crafted from soft organic cotton voile, it’s newly rendered with delicate allover dotted embroidery. Designed with full-length raglan sleeves and a wide stand collar, it’s finished with a line of mother-of-pearl buttons down the center front.

title: JULIENNE TOP -- SALT MARSEILLE EMBROIDERY
desc: The Julienne is an iteration of one of our earliest styles, the Jane Blouse. Crafted from soft organic cotton voile, it’s newly rendered with delicate allover dotted embroidery. Designed with full-length raglan sleeves and a wide stand collar, it’s finished with a line of mother-of-pearl buttons down the center front.

title: ISCHIA DRESS -- VERT PETIT BOUQUET DE CHAMONIX
desc: A beloved Favorite Character, the Ischia Dress returns in soft, midweight organic cotton voile patterned with our Petit Bouquet de Chamonix print. The romantic silhouette features double-puffed sleeves, a scoop neckline, and a smocked bodice with two adjustable ties. Petite ruffles trim the neckline and sleeve cuffs, while the fully-lined ankle-grazing skirt is finished with shirring and princess seams for graceful movement.

title: QUINELLE DRESS -- BLACK
desc: Taking cues from our beloved Quinn Dress, the Quinelle is rendered in crisp organic cotton poplin. title: Linen Olivia Top Wildflowers
desc: The Linen Olivia top is easy breezy! It has a boxy and oversized silhouette, cropped length, and dropped shoulder seams. It has a nice flat laying collar and buttons all the way up! It's running a tad big, so we recommend sizing down on this one. Pair it with the Linen Catalina pant for the perfect all over linen look! About our linen: Our 5 oz linen is super breathable, durable, and absorbent (perfect for those hot humid summer days!). title: Puff Top Wildflowers
desc: Go fancy and free in this easy to wear jersey top with feminine detailing. Made from our soft stretchy jersey, the body of this top is fitted and perfect for tucking into higher waisted bottoms. desc: Flynn really is everything: fancy enough for the finest parties, comfortable enough for those who would rather be at home, get-naked-when-you-pee enough for the exhibitionist with taste. Rich emerald velvet is further elevated by a dapper tuxedo-inspired lapel, decorative double-button front, and shoulder-baring halter neck. Pair with a high shoe and an updo, and prepare to razzle and dazzle!

title: LOUISE DRESS EMERALD SEQUIN
desc: For too long, sequined mesh has been sidelined to the summer months. We say: no more! Our Louis dress offers a surprisingly grown-up take on your raver cousin’s favorite fabric. A sumptuous, shimmery deep green textile is a delicate balance of comfort and class, while the high neck and mini silhouette show just the right amount of skin. Pair with sheer tights and stilettos for a sultry party look, or keep things casually festive with a cardigan and loafers.

title: LAURA DRESS CASINO
desc: Rendered in flattering deep teal–a perfect between-seasons hue, evocative of a frothy autumnal sea or a syrupy concoction sipped whilst strolling the Strip–our Laura dress pairs girlish charm with a hefty dose of sin. Frilled hemlines, a pintucked bib, and ties at the waist and collar provide rococo glamor, while a pattern of smokers, gamblers, and dancers ensure you'll never look too uptight.

title: NEGRONI MOCKNECK SWEATER
desc: The warmth of a manhattan, the swank of a martini: the negroni has it all. Just like its namesake, this 100% cotton knit pullover is equal parts unfussy and elevated. Wear atop the Cupcake pant and revel in knowing you're the comfiest person at the holiday party, or pair with a short skirt and a slim heel for an "I like you–but not too much" cool girl date look.

title: LORELAI JACKET BURGUNDY & ICE BLUE
desc: After rigorous case studies and consulting the world's utmost experts in pastel sheep cloning, we're thrilled to present Lorelai: a wear-anywhere outfit elevator that boasts eye-catching burgundy vinyl and faux sheepskin trim in the perfect shade of winter blue. With its hip-grazing, slightly boxy fit, Lorelai is an ideal choice for treks to the skating rink, smoke breaks outside your in-laws' house, pissing your name in the snow, and more.

title: CHELSEA SKIRT BLACK
desc: The perfect piece for your next holiday bash, midnight disco, or sugar daddy's funeral! A rare balance of party and practical, the Chelsea skirt boasts a midi hemline that'll stay put in the strongest of winter gusts, a belly button-baring mid-rise waist, and 360 degrees of shimmering black paillettes. Slip under a cozy sweater to bring a little va-voom to year-end work events, or go full disco queen with the matching Hayley top.

title: HAYLEY TOP BLACK
desc: Silky, spangled, stretchy, cool: as far as party tops go, Hayley's got it all. Sensuous sheer mesh meets cascading paillettes to cover your bits without curbing your ability to boogie on the dance floor, bawl in the bathroom, and brawl in the back alley. (Nobody makes you cry and gets away with it.) Dress like the goth disco ball you are by pairing with the matching Chelsea skirt.

title: CUPCAKE TRACK PANT BLACK
desc: Whether you're a track and field star or struggling to track your period each month, you deserve a track pant that delivers. We've updated our best-selling Cupcake pant with sporty-yet-sophisticated looping stripes down the side of each leg, providing the illusion of speed and grace next time you walk into work 20 minutes late with a latte. Cupcake purists, fear not: we've kept the plush 100% cotton knit and wear-anywhere silhouette you know and love.

title: NICO HALF-ZIP SWEATER BLACK
desc: Quarter zips are well and good, but a half zip? Now we're talking! Commit to the bit–a.k.a. your cleavage–in Nico, a luxurious 100% cotton knit pullover that features a cropped fit, convertible turtleneck collar, dainty pearl zipper pull, and cream trim at the wrists. Pair with the Cupcake track pant and bring upscale MILF energy to any occasion.

title: RYAN QUARTER-ZIP SWEATER
desc: Whether you're racing down a snowy slope or racing downtown for happy hour, Ryan ensures you'll arrive in style. Our 100% cotton knit pullover features a slightly oversized fit, a sporty striped collar, and original ski motifs on the front and back. Slip over a body-skimming dress for a cool girl date night look, or pair with your comfiest joggers to turn any Duane Reade into your personal chalet.

title: NO SMOKING MOCKNECK
desc: Rules that beg to be broken, the limits against one thrusts oneself: sexiness is all about restraint. What better way to celebrate the tension of desire than with an homage to No Smoking neon? Whether you're cheekily lighting up, authentically anti-cigarette, or simply nostalgic for a time before vapes, this 100% cotton mockneck pullover brings a whiff of back alley bad girl energy to grocery shopping, gossipy dinners, galavanting through the midnight streets, and beyond.

title: FLORIST TURTLENECK
desc: Much like your rack, few can resist the siren's call of a neon sign. Our latest turtleneck celebrates both! An elusive mix of demure and horny, this medium-weight pullover features a 100% cotton knit construction, a coy turtleneck collar, and a chainstitch homage to neon Florist signage. Pair with your favorite jeans to elevate an errands day, or with a tall boot and a bold lip for a late-night tryst.

title: YASMIN KNIT PANT BLACK
desc: At long last and after rigorous experimentation, we're thrilled to say we've designed the perfect pants for shaking your ass. Crafted from a plush knit, Yasmin offers full coverage without sacrificing range of motion, so you can have a Flashdance moment without actually flashing anyone. The softly flared silhouette can be dressed up or down with ease, but the pièce de résistance? Floaty fringe trim encircling your waist and ass, complimented by tiny tassels at the ankle.

title: RAMONA SKIRT WELCOME HOME, CHEETAH
desc: The cheetah-print skirt is a heady mix of UES aunt and Atlantic City cousin, haute fête and hangover brunch. Our take on this party season staple is upgraded with a luxe silky textile, a scarf-inspired waist tie, and an asymmetrical slitted hemline. Dress down with a knit sweater and a leather loafer, or strut the fine line between refined and feral by pairing with our Hayley top.

title: ALMITRA MINI DRESS WELCOME HOME, CHEETAH
desc: Many claim to want to be the talk of the town, but few have the moxie to truly embrace drama. Enter Almitra, an unabashedly attention-grabbing party dress that all but ensures you'll be the subject of positive gossip wherever you go. (In regards to your outfit, at least–we claim no responsibility for gossip related to your behavior.) In addition to our statement-making Welcome Home Cheetah print, Almitra features a strapless neckline with a cheeky keyhole cutout, a sultry body-skimming fit, and theatrical puffs of fabric at the hemline.

title: HOT DOG SWEATER
desc: Finally, a fair isle for the pet food aisle! Our Hot Dog sweater features a festive parade of dachshunds clomping around your collarbone, just as it should be. This cloud-like alpaca blend knit fits just a tad oversized, making it ideal for curling up with a book, stepping out with a slim jean and a jaunty boot, or retreating into yourself during an insufferable dinner party conversation.

title: DOLLY MIDI SKIRT MOO
desc: Rootin’, tootin’, but never high-falutin’: Dolly’s got it all! Our brand-new midi skirt sports an A-line silhouette and a becoming cow print in 100% printed cotton twill, plus swishy fringe trim that begs you to scoot boots. Pair with tennies and a well-worn t-shirt for an elevated weekend look, or throw on a bolo tie and some glittery eyeshadow to relive that Sex and the City scene where Miranda dominates the mechanical bull.

title: SHANNEN SKORT ARGYLE
desc: Maybe you don't believe in binaries, maybe you fear showing hole; whatever the reason, we all adore a skort. Keep your legs bare but your lap covered in Shannen, an asymmetrical mini fashioned from plush, slightly stretchy cotton with argyle all over. A soft palette of earthy brown and green evokes the rarest of '70s Pyrex, while a high-low hem keeps this look up to date.

title: CORI CARDIGAN ARGYLE
desc: With a dash of plaid, a hint of harlequin, and a healthy dose of horny librarian, we feel argyle is undersung. Our homage to this pair-with-anything print is a 100% cotton knit in our best-selling Cori silhouette: a cropped cardigan that looks great opened, buttoned, or slipping off one's shoulders. Throw on over our Cupcake pant to elevate your next bodega run, or pair with the matching Shannen skort for a deceptively simple party look.

title: ADRIEN SHIRT BUTTER
desc: Is there any greater diner’s delight than a fancy butter pat? It’s like a brooch for the table! Adrian’s relaxed bowling shirt silhouette is balanced by a prissy little heart pocket and covered in artisanally sculpted butter. Tuck into high-waisted shorts, wear unbuttoned over a lacy chemise, or go high fashion and high cholesterol with the matching H.W. overalls.

title: ROSE PANT DOG SCRAWL
desc: Dogs on your stems? Now you're barking up the right tree! With its hoard of hounds, our latest Rose is an extremely chic homage to your cheery neighborhood dog walker. (Sans poop bags, of course.) The silky twill textile is both easy and luxe, and the wide-leg silhouette makes your ass look particularly sniff-worthy. For a real top dog ensemble, pair with the matching Jeanne blazer.

title: JEANNE BLAZER DOG SCRAWL
desc: Jeanne takes you from the office to pissing on a fire hydrant with style and grace. Our newest blazer's businessy silhouette is made cocktail hour-ready with a deep V-neckline, silky twill, and a Parisian cafe's worth of doted-upon dogs. For a look that says "Your house, my house, or the dog house," pair with the matching Rose pant.

title: CORI CARDIGAN WASN'T ME
desc: We're brave enough to say it: not enough revenge outfits consider the avenged's comfort. With its plush cotton knit, boxy fit, and-all over scrawled lipstick print, our latest Cori is a long-awaited comfy take on retribution. Pair with our Mike pant for a fiery anytime ensemble, or with a mini skirt and bitchy heel to remind them that no one is better dressed than a woman scorned.

title: SARDINE TIN TURTLENECK
desc: We never read Cannery Row, so we'll just have to assume it's an uplifting treatise on the sartorial strengths of tinned fish. Similarly, our latest pullover is a bright celebration of everyone's favorite toast topping. A 100% cotton knit keeps you cozy on the couch, in the bar, or at sea, while an oversized sardine tin intarsia turns your rack into a well-appointed pantry shelf.

title: SAND ART KNIT DRESS
desc: Was your sexual awakening a curvy glass bottle filled with colorful sand? Um, us neither! Embody this deceptively sensual summer camp craft in our latest autumn dress, a sensual fuzzy mini covered in cascading colorblock stripes. Perfect on its own, we also recommend layering the Sand Art dress with a Lillian top or adding some googly eyes.

title: COCKTAIL BAR MOCKNECK
desc: Our newest fall sweater contains multitudes: fun enough for 5pm and cozy enough for 5am, the Cocktail Bar mockneck exudes the delicious sleaze of a late-night dive while remaining office appropriate. This midweight 100% cotton pullover is the perfect warmth for layering with a slip dress, throwing on over your trusty bodega run sweats, or drying off after your next wet t-shirt contest.

title: MANHATTAN SWEATER
desc: With all the depth of whisky and sweet vermouth in a light little coup glass, the Manhattan is an undersung study in balance. In a similar fashion, our Manhattan sweater elegantly blurs the line between a party look and a passed-out-on-the-sofa look. This 100% cotton pullover features a perfectly calibrated medium-warmth knit, cozy ribbed trim, and a larger-than-life manhattan served up.

title: JULIA DRESS WASN'T ME
desc: While we can't legally claim our latest mini dress is an homage to a certain '90s cheater anthem, we will say that Julia is nearly guaranteed to get you laid on the counter, on the sofa, in the shower, on camera, and anywhere else you may desire. (Allegedly.) Here, a flowy skirt, pleated front, and sweet bow tie are delightfully corrupted by our brand new Lipstick Scrawl print.

title: JEWEL JUMPSUIT TREE OF LOST JEWELS
desc: Buried treasure: romantic in theory, frustratingly hard to keep track of in real life. Body treasure: just as precious, and easily located (hint–it's all over you). Put away the metal detector and break out our latest Jewel, a one-and-done jumpsuit laden with a heist's worth of glitzy jewelry. In addition to the contents of the prop trailer for Oceans Fourteen, Jewel boasts the short-sleeved, straight-legged cut that made this silhouette a best seller.

title: PEGGY DRESS TREE OF LOST JEWELS
desc: Dress like the jewelry box ballerina you are, in Peggy! This sumptuous velvet mini features a romantic tangle of gold chains and a Met gala of gemstones, ensuring you'll look like a million karats at the opera, the operations meeting, and beyond. Pair with a slim heel for an effortless date look, or dress down with a lug-soled loafer and bring a little glitz to your local dive.

title: RAMONA SKIRT PURR PAISLEY
desc: All the paisley, none of the patchouli: Ramona is a thoroughly contemporary take on everyone's favorite hippie print. Crafted from silken crepe de chine, this midi's modest hemline is gleefully subverted with a rakish scarf tie at the waist and a thigh-high hemline. Wear with tights and a lug-soled loafer for a cool office look!

title: ELOISE TOP PURR PAISLEY
desc: The sensual delight of a scarf top is, for many of us, sadly tempered by the fear of one's tits falling out. Allow us to assuage your anxiety and accentuate your rack with Eloise, a silky crepe de chine piece that boasts a one-shoulder silhouette and our trippy Purr Paisley print. Pair with light denim for laid-back Lilith Faire vibes!

title: ANN SWEATER PERFUME BOTTLES
desc: Just because you smell like cigarettes and sadness doesn't mean your aura has to! Like dry shampoo for the soul, the Ann sweater's delicately embroidered perfume bottles bring an air of freshness and glamour to any ensemble. Pair with your favorite jeans and a kitten heel for a devil-may-care date look, or balance Ann's chunky knit silhouette with a sleek silk pant.

title: LIPSTICK SKIRT
desc: Whether it's the sign of infidelity or simple clumsiness, lipstick on one's clothing gets a bad rap. We're here to rehabilitate–nay, elevate–lipstick-covered clothing with an eminently wearable set that's equal parts comfy and coquettish. This deep blue 100% cotton knit skirt is trimmed with a line of lipsticks and finished with playful decorative buttons. Make it a real affair with the matching Lipstick polo sweater.

title: LIPSTICK POLO SWEATER
desc: If kink breaks the bond between transgression and shame, then our Lipstick polo is one sick puppy. This 100% cotton knit pullover boldly reclaims lipstick on one's collar with a whole vanity's worth of maquillage for your décolletage, plus vampy pink and red buttons. Pair with the matching Lipstick skirt for a slutty secretary look you could actually wear to the office.

title: DAN PANT NAVY
desc: Pant s less Zoom calls, assless chaps, jeggings: we're in a historical moment for butts, in which one might question the very nature of wearing bottoms. Our Dan pant bravely explores this philosophical query without getting you into hot water with HR. What appears at first sight to be a buttoned-up suit pant is in fact a soft, slightly slouchy knit that's ready for the classroom, the boardroom, the brunch cafe, and civil court. (For criminal court, we recommend consulting with your lawyer.) Pair with our Serena or Blair tops, or don all three at once for the ultimate mix of business and leisur

title: BLAIR CARDIGAN NAVY
desc: In the grand tradition of keyboard ties and tuxedo tees, we love a trompe-l'œil moment. Our latest cardigan is no exception, though we'd like to think we've elevated the form: Blair features a super soft 100% cotton construction and boxy cardigan silhouette, plus a trick-of-the-eye suit collar, pocket, and pen. Pair with the matching Dan pant and exert dominance in comfort at your next liquid lunch.

title: SERENA TOP NAVY
desc: Finally: a top that's business in style and party in execution. This 100% cotton knit tank provides a punch of prep and plenty of cheek with a trompe-l'œil tie and trim for your next Dilbert erotic cosplay party. Layer over a button-down for the office, or pair with the Dan pant and bring new meaning to business casual. The only downside is no one can pull you close by the tie–but, one might argue, Serena's creamy contrast collar works just fine.

title: MIMI JACKET MEDICINE CABINET
desc: Isn't it kind of delightful how perfume commercials don't make any sense? A beautiful stranger rides a horse into the sea, and somehow that represents top notes of bergamot. We've continued this grand tradition of translating perfume to other mediums with a jacket that is delightfully surreal and utterly practical all at once. Crafted from cozy quilted taffeta and covered in painterly perfume bottles, Mimi features a full collar for cold days, a cinched silhouette, and soft down-alternative fill.

title: FLEMING SHIRT MEDICINE CABINET
desc: Finally, a button-up that screams, "Where do you hide your meds?" Inspired by the devilish desire to poke around other people's bathrooms at a party–we all have that impulse, right?–Fleming features a captivating perfume collection on cocaine decor glass shelves, all crafted in semi-sheer 100% silk georgette. Wear under a cozy cardigan and add a bit of sensuality to chilly day errands, or layer over the Cleo dress for an extra pop of interest.

title: CLEO DRESS MEDICINE CABINET
desc: A femme fatale should be a little difficult, as a rule, but the same doesn't go for her outfit. Embrace high drama and a breeze around your nether regions in Cleo, a wear-anywhere slip dress that exudes sex appeal without sacrificing comfort. Silky crepe de chine and a body-skimming silhouette can be dressed up or down, while our brand new Medicine Cabinet print brings the thrill of snooping to any occasion.

title: MADDY DRESS VA VA VOOM
desc: This fall, our fan-favorite Maddy dress gets a Va-Va-Voom upgrade! Consider this mini the deeply erotic cousin of those fake bikini shirts you buy on the boardwalk; splashed across Maddy's form-fitting front, you'll find a trompe-l'œil sequined bustier dress inspired by America's favorite trophy wife and Roger Rabbit defender. A soft and stretchy 100% cotton knit construction ensures this dress can keep up with drinks, dancing, and whatever other–ahem–activities your outfit may inspire.

title: IDA SKIRT IT'S FOR YOU
desc: Tangling oneself in the telephone cord in a fit of great gossip is, sadly, a lost art. Embrace the analogue and honor your inner mom-who-just-needs-five-goddamn-minutes in our latest fall mini! Ida features a soft and stretchy 100% cotton construction and a wraparound pink telephone cord so chic, you'll want to throw your cell into the sea. Pair with the matching Cori cardigan and call it a party line.

title: CORI CARDIGAN IT'S FOR YOU
desc: Not so long ago, the telephone wasn't an instrument of procrastination and doom. Bring back the joy of a good long-distance yap in our latest Cori, a 100% cotton fully-fashioned knit with a wraparound phone jacquard that says, "Not now darling, mommy's on the other line." Shiny buttons, plush ribbed trim, and a cropped, slightly boxy silhouette will have you looking hotter than a 999 number.

title: LILLY DRESS EVIDENCE
desc: Sometimes you're the femme fatale, and sometimes you're the PI at her heels. Embrace duality in Lilly, a svelte little party dress in a brand new noir-inspired print. Sheer sleeves and a slinky turtleneck bring a hint of coyness to this mesh mini, on which you'll find all the paraphernalia of a good stakeout: binoculars, ashtrays, cryptic notes and hotel keys abound. Ask your date to follow the clues, and enjoy wherever they take you.

title: OTIS SWEATER EVERGREEN
desc: Basset hounds get their name from the French bas, meaning low or short. There's nothing wrong with skimming the pavement, but we felt it was time for these low-riding dogs to reach new heights–specifically, your rack. This 100% cotton fully-fashioned knit features a fitted silhouette, plush ribbed trim, and a festive holiday hound complete with a tactile puff ball on his dapper cap.

title: ALEC DRESS DOG SCRAWL
desc: Like the best shelter dogs, Alec is one interesting mix: crafted from gala-ready emerald crepe de chine, this dusk-to-dawn midi's wide sleeves and contrast piping bring to mind a sexy '70s pajama party, while its adjustable wrap waist evokes a silver screen siren's jauntily tied scarf. Add in enough dogs to make a Westminster judge's heart flutter, and you've got a piece that turns any outfit into more than the sum of its parts.

title: CLAUD DRESS TARTAN
desc: Dress like the bitchiest girl at boarding school, in Claud! Crafted in complimentary tartan plaids, a menswear-inspired silhouette is shaken up with a contrasting tie belt and structural high-low hemline. Pair with a heeled loafer for a deceptively unfussy office ensemble, or with a cunty heel for a look that says "My father won't be too happy to hear about this."

title: CHELSEA SKIRT CLASSIFIEDS
desc: The classifieds are a magical place where anything is possible; one can find under-the-table gigs and psychic guidance within three inches of print, then offload a sofa and take on a lover. Our Classifieds print finds a fitting new home on Chelsea, a slinky mesh midi skirt that'll spice up an errands run, freshen up a dinner date, or bring a hint of sophistication to your next backpage encounter.

title: BRUNO JEAN CLASSIFIEDS
desc: Our latest Bruno pant promises to keep your ass front-page and above the fold. This best-selling silhouette sports a medium rise, a straight leg, and carpenter pant front panels that scream "I could fix my sink if I wanted, I just don't want to"--plus a brand new all-over Classifieds print full of delightful details and hidden gems, so you'll never be bored on the subway again.

title: BLANCHE TOP CLASSIFIEDS
desc: We've freed the classifieds from the backpages and put 'em front and center on your tits! Celebrate the section of sales and scandals with Blanche, a body-hugging mesh crop top featuring coy wrist-grazing sleeves, a crew neck collar, and lipstick red lettuce edges. Pair with the matching Chelsea skirt for a look that screams "sirens deserve stretchy waistbands, too."

title: MIKE PANT WELCOME HOME, CHEETAH
desc: We recently realized our robust collection of Mikes was missing something--a certain je ne sais quoi, an elusive blend of tacky and tasteful most often seen on fun aunts, fortune tellers, and boardwalk babes. Enter our latest take on the best-selling pant: Mike's signature high waist, wide leg, and roomy pockets, plus an all-over cheetah print. Tuck in a lingerie-inspired top, slip on our Jordana jacket, and claim victory at your next Samantha Jones lookalike contest!

title: CHLOE COIN PURSE DRESS WELCOME HOME, CHEETAH
desc: For far too long, party girls have been punished for their immaculate style and penchant for losing their keys. We say: no more! Chloe boasts not only a thigh-grazing bubble hemline and a brazen all-over cheetah print, but a fully functional coin purse at the halter neckline to keep your hands free and your treasures safe while out on the town. Hold onto your credit cards and your dignity, no matter where the night takes you!

title: LILITH DRESS AFTER DARK
desc: Slip into Lilith, step into a bar, and tell the hottest person there it's a sign. Instant rizz! Lilith's sleek mesh construction and body-hugging silhouette are made even more sirenesque with all-over neon signage, ensuring you shine from dusk til dawn and beyond. When you're too busy plotting revenge to plan an outfit, make Lilith and a kitten heel your glamorous go-to.

title: GEORGIA TOP BUTTERCUP TILE
desc: Georgia is back and more Valley of the Dolls than ever! This cropped button-front wonder features the oversized collar and back ribbon-tie closure you know and love, plus an all-over buttercup tile print reminiscent of the powder room in which your grandma stored her good pills. Pair with the matching Sid skort and prepare to dominate your next croquet match, physically and socially.

title: PATSY SHIRTDRESS WILDCARD
desc: Great Aunt Patsy’s at the poker table with a Long Island iced tea in one bejeweled hand and a cigarette in the other, and she’s cleaning house. Pity the businessmen who underestimate her! Our Patsy dress evokes that same thrill of a dark horse with a winning hand, minus the sweaty accountant begging you to kiss his dice. This mini shirt-dress sports Western-inspired trim, a detachable waist belt, and two bespoke playing card prints for maximum luck.

title: MIKE PANT MANHUNT TOILE
desc: For too long, we’ve gatekept our Manhunt print from your ass. Please accept our sincere apologies–and a brand new Mike pant that brings nude men and little Lafittes closer to your cheeks than ever before! Pair Mike’s best-selling high-waist, wide-leg silhouette with tennies and a cozy sweater or svelte tank–or, we humbly suggest you make a matching set with our Lillian top.

title: BRUNO JEAN PURR PAISLEY
desc: Me-ow! Look closely, and you’ll find a mesmerizing menagerie of psychedelic kitties in this bespoke paisley print. In addition to fall’s foremost cat collection, Bruno features a straight-leg painter’s pant silhouette, reinforced front patches, and a fully functional hammer hook for all the construction you’ll be doing in these pants.

title: BRUNO JEAN MOUNTAIN DEW
desc: Bring the joy of the mosh pit to any occasion with Bruno, an acid-washed wonder of a weekend jean in muted Mountain Dew green. An undersung color, in our opinion! In addition to a superb palette and a flattering straight-leg cut, Bruno boasts practical details like roomy pockets, reinforced knee panels, and a nifty utility loop.

title: CORI CARDIGAN MANHUNT TOILE
desc: You asked for more Manhunt, and we listened: introducing our newest and most ass-adorned Cori cardigan yet! This cotton-cashmere knit features a slightly cropped boxy fit–making it perfect for layering over a dress or high-waisted jeans–and all-over Manhunt print, featuring frolicking ladies, naked men, and a cameo from Lafitte himself.

title: LORIA KNIT SHELL FLOWER COOKIE
desc: Let your sweater puppies play in a field of flowers! We’ve adapted our fan-favorite Loria’s Cookies print into a 100% cotton fully-fashioned knit covered in dreamy tactile treats. With a colorway vaguely reminiscent of the toothsome Play-Dohs of yore, contrast piping, and a flattering cropped silhouette, this sweater vest offers celebration for your rack and liberation for your pits. Be the artisanal dough you wish to see in the world!

title: GWEN DRESS SEAFOOD TOWER
desc: Our best-selling seafood tower dress is back–in pink! In our newest Gwen, a rosy picnic print plays backdrop to an embarrassment of briny riches. Sumptuous prawns, suggestive oysters, and a whole fucking lobster adorn a strappy mini with an A-line silhouette, adjustable spaghetti straps, and pleat detailing at the waist. Gwen looks great with sneakers and flats, but we recommend pairing with a fancy sandal and a magnum of champagne.

title: GWEN DRESS CHAMPAGNE TOWER
desc: Understated glamour is nice. Glamour so unrestrained it borders on camp? Divine! This elusive combination of class and spectacle is perfectly encapsulated in the effervescent danger of a champagne tower, and so we perfectly encapsulated the champagne tower on our newest Gwen. Bubbly opalescent beads float across a festive still life of stacked coups, coming to rest on the adjustable straps, while a pleated bust, A-line silhouette, and subtly shiny ballet pink taffeta balance the sweet with chic. Pair with a metallic platform and a tiny clutch, then head to your frenemy’s NYE party and divert a

title: GWEN DRESS APEROL SPRITZ
desc: Glamorous, refreshing, intoxicating: dress for the life you want in our homage to summer's hottest cocktail. An oversized Aperol spritz commands attention on this A-line mini, but the details aren't to be overlooked. Fully lined and lightly textured 100% cotton dobby fabric, subtle waist pleats, and adjustable contrasting straw-inspired spaghetti straps complete the look.

title: IS THIS YOUR CARD PULLOVER
desc: Seduce your local illusionist and scam a few bucks in our newest pullover! This wearable ode to card tricks boasts a pillowy cotton-alpaca knit and a yoke of playing cards at the collar, featuring a front-and-center lucky ace. While we honor sleights of hand, there's no trick to this pullover's functionality; a relaxed fit and ribbed cuffs keep things uncomplicatedly cozy.

title: SLOANE DRESS BLUEBERRIES FOR SAL
desc: Seduce your local grizzly in Sloane, a breezy linen midi-dress that boasts not one but two hues of our fan-favorite blueberry print. Perfect for picnicking, salmon-fishing, and a slew of other date-night activities, Sloane’s fanciful free-fitting skirt is balanced by satisfyingly thick straps and a square neckline. Pair with espadrilles, a wicker basket, and bear spray.

title: GWEN DRESS BLUE PINEAPPLES
desc: Finally: a Boca Raton fever dream you can wear to brunch! Our latest Gwen has the structured bust, straight skirt and thigh-high hemline you know and love, plus a swingers' resort's worth of painterly blue pineapples. Pair with a party heel, a pina colada, and a "saw you from across the bar" attitude.

title: JAMES SHIRT DOTTED FRUITS
desc: "Life of the party" is a heavy crown to bear. We can't heal your hangover, but we can offer you the next best thing: a shirt so festive, no one will notice that wearing it is effortless. The best-selling James shirt boasts a boxy fit, camp collar neckline, and handy front pocket–and now, a brand-new party print of technicolor fruits. Add in a floaty silk voile textile, and you've got a deceptively sexy spin on Fun Uncle Energy. All you're missing is a conversation pit, a lampshade, and seventeen remixes of "Girl from Ipanema."

title: NIKKI SHORT POWDER BLUE FLORAL
desc: Finally, a short that invites botanists to study your ass! Our uber-flattering Nikki short features a thigh-skimming silhouette that allows you to be the meanest girl at summer camp anywhere you go, while a vintage wallpaper-inspired print adds a cheeky touch of ladylike charm. For the full effect, pair with the matching Georgia top and a light sunburn.

title: HOWARD DRESS ALLIUMS
desc: It's no wonder this breezy babydoll is a best-seller: Howard's oversized fit and luxe silk-cotton blend take you from tea party to Tinder date without skipping a beat, while all-over alliums say "Ravish my root cellar, bad boy." Pair with a wedge sandal for a deceptively pulled-together anytime look, or with a knob of butter and a dry white for one hell of a scampi.

title: GEORGIA TOP POWDER ROOM FLORAL
desc: Inspired by a distant relative's bathroom in which you might hide from political discourse or fire up the one-hitter, delicate blue florals grace Georgia's boxy sleeveless silhouette in a light linen blend. Topping things off, sumptuous embroidered trim loops its way across this top's signature oversized babydoll collar.

title: KELLER TOP FLOWERS OF THE MONTH
desc: You could spend years trawling eB ay for the perfect vintage bodice, or you could save yourself some grief and forgo the scent of mothballs with Keller. This shoulder-baring summer top boasts a va-va-voom cropped fit, sweetheart neckline, and boob-boosting contrast piping. Our all-over Flowers of the Month print s oftens Keller's structured silhouette and compliments slacks, jorts, the matching Ray wrap skirt, or baring ass–the choice is yours.

title: RAY WRAP SKIRT FLOWERS OF THE MONTH
desc: Whether your summer plans include sipping tequila sunrises on the beach or watching sunrises e n route to the office , you deserve at least one outfit that says "mentally I am on a Princess cruise." Enter Ray: a flattering adjustable wrap skirt with festive fringe trim and all-over flowers of the month print , so even at your most blackout you won't forget you're a June rose. For the full effect, we highly recommend pairing with the matching Keller top.

title: ANNIE SHIRTDRESS TABLECLOTH
desc: With its asymmetrical hemline, menswear-inspired details, and quaint gingham squares, Annie is unabashedly eclectic without sacrificing wearability. Pair with a leather loafer to be the talk of the water cooler, or with a bold heel to be the most avant-garde entry in your state fair's tablescape competition.

title: ESPRESSO MARTINI MOCKNECK SWEATER BLACK
desc: Finally: a wearable ode to the bon vivant’s Four Loko! This 100% fully fashioned knit lovingly renders the espresso martini in all its hypercaffeinated glory: the soft, slightly oversized intarsia is complimented by a café-ready mockneck and rolled hems. Three-dimensional espresso bean beading allows for endless fidgeting opportunities, ensuring you’ll have something to do with your hands on date night, open mic night, and everywhere in between.

title: KELLER TOP BLUEBERRIES FOR SAL
desc: Sometimes sweet, sometimes sour, often blue: blueberries, they’re just like you! Celebrate everyone's favorite oatmeal topping in Keller, a baby blue crop top with subtly provocative yellow piping along the bust. Match patterns while mixing proportions with the complimentary wide-leg Rose pant, or pair Keller with your favorite faded jeans and a kicky boot.

title: LOLA DRESS RADICCHIO & CITRUS
desc: No shade to mellow-mannered iceberg or charming little gem, but there's something about radicchio: it's a leafy green that's actually red, an unassuming vegetable that'll stand up to a stinky cheese and dom your salad. Our latest lettuce-forward look showcases radicchio and its equally bitchy fruit cousin, citrus, on an uber-flattering day-to-night linen mini dress.

title: TWIST CONE PULLOVER STRAWBERRY PINK
desc: Few things render us powerless like the Pavlovian call of the ice cream truck. In a world of growing distraction and shortened attention, it's a miracle that an old-timey tinny jingle makes children hurl themselves down the sidewalk in pursuit of a dipped cone. Evoke the sugar rush of a Mr. Softee fix, sans drips, in our 100% cotton short-sleeve pullover; we recommend going braless to invoke the thrill of the chase in others.

title: BESSIE POLO PALE BLUE
desc: If no one's called you bucolic recently, we're here to fix that. On the Bessie polo, a meadow-ready bovine beauty sprawls across your rack like your rack is gently rolling hills. Our pale-blue cotton-blend knit is perfectly plush worn layered or on its own, while Bessie's clean-cut collar and ribbed trim separate country from costumey.

title: MORTY SHORT MOO CLASSIC
desc: Ah, the jort: a versatile chimera that traverses the sublime space between crotch and knee with the ease of denim and the edge of an unfinished hem. Our latest spring short is lovingly rendered in sturdy denim with an all-over black and white cow print that invites you to embody your inner dairy queen. Wear with literally anything; animal print always counts as a neutral.

title: CUPCAKE SKORT PINK TOWEL STRIPE
desc: No one wants to be a doormat, but a beach towel? The feeling of hot sand beneath you and hot ass above? Aspirational! Live your fantasy in the Cupcake skort: resort-ready pink stripes and creamsicle orange piping bring OOO energy to our signature stretchy mini skort silhouette. Coordinate with the matching Cupcake cardigan, or top with the Twist Cone Pullover for a look that says "I've got sand in places you've only dreamed of."

title: LOLA DRESS SYNCHRONIZED SWIMMERS
desc: We wouldn't be us if we weren't clothing you in barely-clad ladies. If we do say so ourselves, our latest take on boob-forward fashion is particularly elegant: a kerchief-inspired print reveals tiny synchronized swimmers engaging in Aqualillies-worthy aquatic dance. With a little vintage charm and a moderate amount of ass, these bathing beauties are balanced by our unfussy Lola mini silhouette.

title: SID SKORT CRUDITE
desc: An amuse-bouche that covers your cooch! Our most vegetal Sid yet sports a wrap front, asymmetrical hemline, and secret shorts so you can spread 'em if you got 'em. Wear over a plain tee to class up your next bodega run, or pair with the matching Georgia top for a full serving of style.

title: HARPER DRESS COLOR BY NUMBER
desc: Finally: a dress that is both reminiscent of an acid trip and suitable for brunch. Our latest Harper boasts a structured bodice, flowy skirt, and contrast trim, plus a slightly psychedelic floral inspired by the favorite activity of uninspired children everywhere. Delicate orange and blue blooms drift down to Harper's ankle-grazing hemline, leaving the bottom delightfully undone.

title: KOKOMO SHORT BELLFLOWER STRIPE
desc: Wallpaper your ass like the architectural wonder it is! Our latest Kokomo short has the high waist and pleated front you know and love, plus an updated take on spring florals with a vintage-inspired wallpaper print. To keep things from getting too cutesy, soft pink and green blooms are balanced by Kokomo's boyish bermuda silhouette.

title: CUPCAKE CARDIGAN PINK TOWEL STRIPE
desc: Go from flirting at the funnel cake stand to getting felt up under the boardwalk, in Cupcake! The newest addition to our fan-favorite leisure line brings beachy pink stripes to the cropped fit, scalloped trim, and pearly buttons you know and love. As a bonus, Cupcake's terry knit construction is the perfect weight for spring evenings and the perfect texture for toweling off after skinny dipping.

title: BARRY VEST BELLFLOWER STRIPE
desc: If you've ever wanted to dress like a haunted doll at a backroads BnB, this is the top for you! Our Barry vest boasts a horny dandy-inspired deep V neckline, button details on the front and back, and an all-over floral wallpaper print of sweetly drooping bellflowers. Pair with the matching Kokomo short for the ultimate in wallflower chic.

title: GEORGIA TOP CRUDITE
desc: Up there with fanned napkins and tinfoil swans is the lost art of crudité. Here to revive this unsung appetizer is our newest Georgia, a linen-blend button-up that champions the delight of a curl of cucumber and the delicate sensuousness of a radish rosette. Along with enough veggies to stock a rabbit's key party, Georgia has an oversized babydoll collar, a boxy cropped fit, and a dainty tie at the back neckline.

title: JAMES SHIRT GREEN RADICCHIO & CITRUS
desc: The food pyramid may be propaganda, but it's still sexy to love vegetables. Our latest James makes it easy to advertise your elite taste with a garden of radicchio and citrus rendered in lush painterly tones. James' best-selling camp shirt silhouette features a slightly oversized fit and a handy pocket to hold your salad dressing.

title: SECOND COMING TEE
desc: You have to feel it - to believe it! Designed in collaboration with Searchlight Pictures, limited edition t-shirt inspired by The Testament of Ann Lee. From award-winning writer-director Mona Fastvold (The World to Come, The Brutalist) comes the extraordinary true legend of Ann Lee, founder of the devotional sect known as the Shakers. Award-winning Amanda Seyfried stars as the Shaker's irrepressible leader, who preached gender and social equality and was revered by her followers. The Testament of Ann Lee captures the ecstasy and agony of her quest to build a utopia, featuring more than a dozen

title: REBECCA DRESS HOUSE SALAD
desc: Women laughing while eating a salad? Cliché. Women laughing while wearing a salad? Gourmet! Radish, radicchio, and those sexy onions with the greens attached are just a few of the veggies on display on our freshest dress to date. An open back, breezy cotton-silk voile, and a removable entrée-sized bow tie back makes for a look that’s as decadent as it is sensible.

title: GEORGIA TOP GAME SET MATCH
desc: If our Georgia top is reminiscent of a cursed American Girl doll, the latest addition to the collection is from the historical period of Challengers . Embrace rackets on your rack with all-over embroidered tennis equipage on a vibrant court-green 100% cotton backdrop. Georgia's signature boxy fit and babydoll collar make for a winning serve.

title: LILA DRESS FLOWERS OF THE MONTH
desc: You asked, we answered: Lila is a party look on which you can blow your nose with abandon. In addition to an ethereal twill textile and an easy-to-pee-in A-line mini silhouette, Lila features a hemline of wispy voile cocktail napkins embroidered with flowers of the month. Ask your crush to find their birth flower, and let the flirtation begin–we recommend doing this before wiping up any stains, but support you no matter what.

title: CHELSEA SKIRT SNAKES
desc: Snakes in a can is a classic prank, but snakes on your can? Seriously chic, no jokes about it. This sleek mesh mini features a body-hugging fit, 3/4 lining, and wildly comfortable stretch waistband. Pair with the matching Stella top for a slightly more highbrow and far less smelly alternative to wearing your city zoo's reptile house.

title: STELLA TOP SNAKES
desc: Stella ensures you'll demand respect, yearning, and perhaps a little fear at your next Greek pantheon -themed orgy -slash-cocktail-party . A Medusa's mane of colorful snakes adorns this slinky mesh top, which also features a body-skimming fit and playful raw hem. Pair with the matching Chelsea skirt and prepare to turn your crush to stone. (Because they'll get so hard... you get it.)

title: MORTY SHORT RED RADISHES
desc: Put some roots on your stems in Morty, a short with high vitamin C! (Not really. Please don't eat our shorts.) Morty's true blue denim and knee-grazing raw hemline are a study in effortless cool, while the all-over radish print screams "Butter me like one of your French hors d'oeuvres."

title: SYLVIE CUPCAKE MINI DRESS RED
desc: We're not saying Sylvie was expressly designed for hooking up, but we'd be remiss not to acknowledge this mini's beguiling thigh-high hemline and easy-to-slip-on-and-off silhouette. What's more , our sensuous terry textile is t he winsome crimson birds exploit to a ttract mates--w ho are we to defy nature? Scalloped trim and dainty pocket buttons add just enough innocent charm to make things really interesting.

title: MARGARITA POLO LIME
desc: What's the hottest way to rep a frozen beverage? A big ol' marg on your rack, of course! A frosty margarita adorns this fresh green cotton knit, complimented by a polo collared V-neck, a ribbed hem, and a garnish of lime trim. Pair with a floaty maxi skirt to entice your local Parrot-head, or layer over a button-up for an office look that says "I'd rather be wasted."

title: RADISH SHELL SWEATER BLUE
desc: For a vegetable that grows in the dirt, this radish is a deceptively easy way to clean up. A plush 100% cotton knit and sleeveless crew silhouette add a touch of garden glamor to jeans or a layering top while the larger-than-life fuzzy radish and textured trim is a tactile delight. (Also, a great conversation starter if you'd like someone to touch your boobs.)

title: POPSICLE TANK BUBBLEGUM PINK
desc: Thanks to our newest tank, you can now embody the nostalgic delight of a drippy popsicle without getting sticky. Super-soft 100% cotton depicts a cool blue-green graphic popsicle on a bubblegum background, plus mix-n-match teal trim at the collar and straps.

title: VICTORIA DRESS BLUE RADISHES
desc: Ravishing in radishes! Be the temptress of your local produce plot–every community garden needs one–in our latest Victoria dress. Constructed in decadent cotton sateen, this midi dress features a structured sweetheart neckline, contrast piping, and all-over pop art-esque blue radish print.

title: CINDY DRESS DOTTED FRUITS
desc: Our latest Cindy may just be the Platonic ideal of a party dress: a jersey bodice ensures comfort from dance floor to bathroom floor and beyond, while clouds of puffy cotton lend the illusion of grace to even the most doubly left-footed. Add a head-turning tropical fruit print, and Life of the Party status has never been more attainable.

title: MINNIE DRESS COCKATOOS
desc: There's something so beguiling about a look that unabashedly evokes a full-chested "Hubba hubba." Make tongues wag and eyes bulge with Minnie, a brave little mini dress sporting a body-skimming fit, ruched bust, and adjustable spaghetti straps–plus an all-over cockatoo print perfect for a low-effort, high-reward mating dance.

title: LOLA DRESS ICE CREAM TRUCK
desc: You likely already have suitors chasing you down the block, but Lola invites you to make your siren's call all the more literal. This mini's best-selling A-line sleeveless silhouette is complimented by mouthwateringly irreverent takes on fudgesicles, chipwiches, snowballs, and more.

title: LIZZIE JACKET INDIGO W/ PATCHES
desc: The newest Lizzie Jacket invokes your inner crafty aunt, without submitting to hours of macrame! Our best-selling boxy chore coat features structured indigo denim, handy oversized pockets, and now, all-over patches that commemorate Troop RA's greatest achievements. Throw on over a party dress for a dressed-down date night look, or mix-n-match with any of our printed Mike pants.

title: MIKE PANT BORSCHT BROCHURES
desc: What's blue and white and Borscht all over? Your ass in our newest Mike! Easily zhuzhed up or dressed down, this eminently wearable wide-leg pant features all-over trompe-l'œil dinette menus, hiking maps, and other Catskill delights.

title: ANA CARDIGAN PINEAPPLE CAKE
desc: Pineapple truly has it all: a don't-fuck-with-me exterior, a sweet-sour flavor profile, and a reputation as the fruit of choice for citric acid aficionados and swingers alike. Our latest Ana cardigan invites you to enjoy all pineapple has to offer, without burning the roof of your mouth: this cropped sweater features plush 100% cotton, a slightly boxy fit, tortoiseshell buttons, and all-over pineapple rings reminiscent of your boozy nana's favorite baked good.

title: PINA COLADA TANK MARASCHINO
desc: Rupert Holmes put piña coladas on the Top 40, and in the tradition of grand homages, we're here to put them on your tits. This 100% cotton tank boasts a perfect mid-weight knit, striped straps and trim, and a life-sized cocktail intarsia with all the fixings. Wear under our Ana cardigan to dominate your next swingers' party.

title: CUPCAKE SKORT GREY
desc: If you spend your nights begging God to deliver crotch-covering fashion in the dulcet hue of baby doves and Zoloft commercials, well, your somewhat niche prayers have been answered! Our latest Unbasic Basic sports all the hallmarks of its fan-favorite predecessors: comfy stretch cotton, a high waist, and contrasting scalloped trim, plus plush cotton terry in the perfect shade of grey.

title: FREDDIE DRESS TABLECLOTH
desc: Exude the hedonistic glow of a fine charcuterie spread in Freddie, a picnic-inspired mini that's more luxury than Lunchables. Festive colorblocked ruffles pop on this poppyseed gingham linen shift dress, making it the ideal choice for your next barbecue, park date, or erotic cold cuts roleplay session.

title: AUBREY DRESS RADICCHIO & CITRUS
desc: Bitter ex? Uncomfortable and all too long-lasting. Bitter vegetables? Delightful, but ephemeral. Have only the best of both worlds, with our wilt-proof Radicchio and Citrus print! Reimagined in balmy blues and greens, a veritable bushel of lettuce and tangerines graces Aubrey's regal maxi silhouette. Pair with a fancy flat for a look that says, "Stay salty, I'm thriving in salad."

title: JACLYN MAXI DRESS POLKA DOT
desc: Elegant enough for a beach wedding, sexy enough for a bachelorette, voluminous enough to hide a flask on each hip: Jaclyn is a one-stop showstopper of a dress. This maximal maxi features a gathered bust, a flattering sloped empire waist, and luxe silk voile in playful contrasting polka dots.

title: VICTORIA DRESS PAINTED OVER MIX
