desc: Evoke the spirit of the French Riviera on even the sweatiest subway ride with Victoria, a floaty, flirty midi dress that boasts beachy blue stripes, a becoming structured bust, and adjustable open tie back. Pair with platforms and a sun hat to breeze around town, or with worn-in white tennies for a laissez-faire errands-running look.

title: RADLEY SHIRTDRESS BORSCHT BROCHURES
desc: Radley is the sort of dress Nancy Drew would wear while solving crime and kicking ass, back when solving crime and kicking ass still required you to be a lady. Our wildly flattering shirtdress features a nipped waist, open skirt, cheeky menswear-inspired collar and all-over Borscht Brochures print.

title: NICO HALF-ZIP GREY
desc: Mall-walkers, sailor collars, that guy who sells his nonna's meatballs from his stoop: Nico is a piece of many muses. This 100% cotton terry knit pullover features a slightly slouchy fit, a square collar with scalloped trim, and a comely zippered neckline that lets you steer the SS Cleavage. Wear over the matching Cupcake skort and showcase the classiest tracksuit around.

title: LOLA DRESS SNAKES
desc: Snake in the grass: scary. Snake on a dress: sexy! Lola brings the heat in both form and function with a mini hemline, breezy shift silhouette, and a veritable reptile house’s worth of colorful snakes. For a sinfully easy evening look, add a pair of espadrilles and a smear of lipstick and prepare to turn heads. “Red next to yellow is a dangerous fellow; me next to you is a dream come true.” The pick-up lines write themselves!

title: SID SKORT GAME SET MATCH
desc: Game, set, match–as in, up your game with our newest matching set. With a flirty high hemline and functional undershorts, Sid is a practical choice for forehands on the court and foreplay in the locker room . Pair with the matching Georgia top and a stiff mojito for the ultimate in country club cunt.

title: H.W. OVERALLS BUTTER
desc: What may appear, at first, to be a pastel field of flowers is in fact something far more romantic: butter! A dozen Dennys’ worth of tiny toothsome butter pats dot our H.W. overalls. This print is dreamy, to be sure, but these bad boys are made for the real world: H.W.’s robust low-stretch denim is complimented by bib, hip, and back utility pockets, and even a loop for your hammer (or, if you’re enterprising, more butter).

title: DORINDA BIKE SHORT ESPECIALLY THE BEANS
desc: Green beans, pink beans, purple beans, short beans, long beans…your ass has been bereft of them all, until today! Our classic Dorinda short features plush French terry, a not-too-short-not-too-long 7-inch inseam, and a body-hugging silhouette. Pair with an oversized t-shirt for cozy errands-running, or pair with the James shirt for a look that says “Yes, I’m wearing a summer suit of beans.”

title: SAL JUMPSUIT PINK MOO
desc: Yoo-hoo, indeed! Our newest Sal is sure to invoke both hootin’ and hollerin’ with a comely chocolate milk cow print on a hot pink background. Sal’s denim construction provides structure with a smidge of stretch for a body-skimming fit, and a full-length front zipper makes slipping on and off a breeze.

title: UMBRELLA SHORT BLUE & WHITE STRIPE
desc: Dressing in a towel? Cute, but overdone. Dressing in an umbrella? That’s innovation, baby! We’re pleased to present the Umbrella short, an entirely new design–and an entirely new concept, we assume, though we haven’t confirmed with the patent office. This floaty, flattering short provides the coverage and style of your favorite seaside accessory but ditches the nylon in favor of a thick-but-breathable 100% cotton knit. Pair with an oversized button-down, or with the complimentary knit top for a look that says “It is I who sells sea shells down by the sea shore.”

title: TASHI ROMPER GREEN
desc: Whether you need a new look for in-laws brunch or your next Challengers erotic role-play convention, Tashi is the romper for you! Fashioned from the perfect polo cotton in bright turf green, this one-stop showstopper features a flirty illusion skirt front, a V-neck, sporty white striped trim, and an embroidered tennis racket insignia. For a beguiling daytime date look, don Tashi with a pair of tennies and prepare your love puns.

title: ANA CARDIGAN RAINBOW CARROTS
desc: Our most vitamin-A infused cardigan yet offers a bounty of multi-hued heirloom carrots in our signature cozy, slightly cropped Ana silhouette. It may not help you see better, but it’ll certainly help you look better! Ana’s cotton-cashmere blend is optimized for fickle spring weather; layer over your favorite tee to withstand spring breezes and overzealous office ACs alike, or wear with nothing underneath and go from Mr. McGregor’s garden to Mr. McGregor’s bedroom with ease.

title: CUPCAKE CARDIGAN LIMEADE TERRY
desc: Limeade: chartreuse's more wearable neighbor and lemonade’s cooler cousin, the one who teaches you sex words and doodles masterpieces in Sharpie on your Converse sneakers. We’ve lovingly alchemized the refreshing exuberance of limeade into a wear-anywhere cardigan crafted from tactilely satisfying terry knit. Wear atop the complimentary Cupcake skort and bring sultry Chia Pet vibes to any function.

title: CUPCAKE SKORT LIMEADE TERRY
desc: With its coltish high-low hemline, luxe terry knit, and limesicle hue, the Cupcake skort is this season’s most fashionable way to avoid a publicly indecency charge. A stretchy pull-on construction is optimized for dressing and undressing with abandon, while scalloped edges add a dash of class to even the most passionate of disrobings. To better your odds of getting to the ripping-off-one’s-clothing stage, we highly recommend topping with the matching Cupcake cardigan.

title: CUPCAKE CARDIGAN SKY BLUE TERRY
desc: The days of exerting dominance at your local mall’s food court are sadly gone, but mourn not: the Cupcake cardigan boldly invites you to once again harness the energy of the bitchiest teen at Sbarro! Crafted in a toothsome terry knit–reminiscent of a certain Y2K hot girl sweatsuit–this cardi possesses a contemporary cropped fit, pearly buttons, and a kittenish scalloped hem. Pair with the matching skort and shoplift from Icing by Claire’s in comfort and style!

title: CUPCAKE SKORT SKY BLUE TERRY
desc: Renowned for its ability to flatter one’s legs while protecting one’s crotch, the Cupcake skort is now available in a balmy blue the color of morning sky, bubblegum ice cream, and the smoke at your problematic cousin’s gender reveal. (Although, in contrast, we’re proud to say no one is calling the fire department on the cupcake skort.) Pair with the matching Cupcake cardigan for some extremely comfy coordination.

title: MIA DRESS FORGET ME NOT
desc: Reminiscent of the Lisbon sisters’ prom frocks in The Virgin Suicides, the Mia dress is a spectacle of 1990s-does-1890s tongue-in-cheek charm. Featuring a gently body-skimming fit, a romantic deep V neckline, and ethereal lacy trim along the sleeves and back, Mia will take you from winsomely chewing a pencil in class to chugging Southern Comfort under the bleachers with ease. What more could you ask from a date-night look?

title: MINNIE DRESS POSTCARDS
desc: We don’t doubt that your rack always projects the message, “Wish you were here,” but just in case: enter Minnie, a paradise of postcards strewn across a spaghetti-strapped mini dress. Let Minnie’s ruched neckline, keyhole cutout, and body-hugging silhouette take you from beach to bar to bar bathroom with the bartender!

title: NANCY DRESS PINK UMBRELLA
desc: Fringed, fabulous, freedom for your thighs: Nancy’s got it all! Inspired by that darling of the dunes–the pastel-flaunting, long-shadow-casting, slightly bawdy beach umbrella–this mini dress is equally unafraid to draw attention: the very wearable color-blocked shift silhouette takes on main character energy with a scalloped hemline and swishy fringe trim. For the full effect, pair with a slender heel and a handful of sand in your ass crack.

title: LOLA DRESS SWIM UP BAR
desc: All the sun-baked bliss of a swim-up bar, none of the chlorine rash! Lola’s signature shift silhouette gets a spring break upgrade with all-over trompe l’oeil water and a wavy wraparound pool bar. Whether basking under a tropical sun or above a sudden burst of hot air from the subway grate, Lola’s 100% cotton twill construction and loose fit ensure you’ll look hot while staying cool.

title: JENNY SHIRTDRESS BLUE PINEAPPLES
desc: Dress like the 1970s swinger you hope your parents weren’t! With a high hemline and a come-hither blue pineapple pattern, the Jenny dress playfully subverts the oft-prude shirtdress silhouette. Contrast striped trim and a detachable waist-tie–or blind fold, up to you–only add to the fun. Wear Jenny with a wedge sandal for a no-brainer date look, or with sneakers to sex up your daily bodega run.

title: HARPER DRESS BUTTERCUP TILE
desc: With a bustier-inspired structured top and a powder room’s worth of dainty tiled buttercups, Harper is a study in sophisticated sex appeal. The springy pastel palette, floaty skirt, and tea-length hemline are office-appropriate, while the sweetheart neckline and structural stitching at the bust say “Meet me in the copy room, stud.”

title: HARPER DRESS GREEN PAINTED OVER
desc: Beach umbrellas, Zebra gum, Hamburglars: all the chicest entities know stripes are in! The Harper dress humbly offers stripes three ways: swathes of kelly green cotton sateen are strategically placed both vertically and horizontally, and sea-blue contrast piping compliments the structured bodice and full skirt’s hemline. Throw on some flats and a pair of statement earrings and prepare to dazzle at your next brunch, breakup post-mortem, or PTA meeting.

title: HOWARD DRESS MARIE THE BAGUETTES
desc: Love a breeze around your undercarriage, and also a nice Brie? Have we got the dress for you! Our famed Howard dress–renowned for its dreamy babydoll silhouette and hint of sheerness at the bust–is now available in our best-selling Marie the Baguettes print. Slip Howard on with a chunky heel, tuck a baguette under your arm, and practice accepting compliments in French.

title: JAMES SHIRT POSTCARDS
desc: If a post card is a tool to induce jealousy–”Look how much fun we’re having!”–then allow us to double your fun with James, a breezy, boxy button-up camp shirt that can’t help but incite sartorial envy. Tucked into cutoffs or jauntily knotted at the waist, this endlessly versatile top has more staying power than a forever stamp.

title: JAMES SHIRT SWIM UP BAR
desc: Why let oversized flower graphics hold the monopoly on vacation shirts? Our newest James reclaims the fun beach button-up from Tommy Bahama’s clutches–your wardrobe deserves joy too! In addition to James’ signature boxy camp shirt fit, you’ll find a delightfully detailed wraparound swim-up bar, complete with a bevy of tropical cocktails. Tucked into jorts or unbuttoned over a filmy tank, James brings much-needed Out Of Office energy to any occasion.

title: KELLER TOP BEACH CHAIRS
desc: A patchwork of beach chairs and pool towels grace Keller’s bustier silhouette, casually tousled as if their tiny owners just dove into your cleavage. Our newest spring top’s structured bodice makes it a perfect choice for date night, while the adjustable spaghetti straps and 100% cotton twill construction promise to keep your pits fresh in even the most humid or awkward environments. For a playful take on the two-piece suit, we recommend the matching Rose pant.

title: SID SKORT BUTTERCUP TILE
desc: Be the highly Instagrammable bathroom you want to see in the world! With its grid of midcentury-inspired buttercups, our latest Sid skort wouldn’t look out of place in the toilettes of fun aunts and it-restaurants, sans the chemical sting of air freshener. A mid-rise fit and flirty front flap balances all those dreamy florals with a bit of sleaze, while the full crotch coverage beneath brings a veneer of ladylikeness to even the most lurid of leg splays.

title: ROSE PANT BLUEBERRIES FOR SAL
desc: What’s long and creased and blue all over? Okay, yes, one’s face after a good cry–but also our newest Rose pant! A cotton-linen blend holds its shape while keeping your ass dry, and our bespoke Blueberries for Sal print is all jam, no thorn. Pair with the matching Keller top and offset your usual debauchery with an air of storybook sweetness.

title: ROSE PANT BEACH CHAIRS
desc: Dress like a seagull’s POV, in Rose! On our newest spring pant, birds-eye beach chairs bask on a plain of 100% cotton twill. While sadly bereft of delicious trash, Rose offers a wide-leg, high-waisted silhouette and flattering little front pleats. Toss on over a bikini for an instant put-together beach look, or go full gull by pairing with the Keller top and stealing your date’s fries.

title: BRUNO JEAN LIGHT BLUE PAINTED OVER
desc: Finally: the elusive blue of post-popsicle tongue is now available for your ass! We kept Bruno’s painter’s pant design–complete with a mid-rise fit, front panels, and a handy legside loop for an Otter Pop on the go–and added slightly off-kilter stripes in a perfect spring blue. Pair with James in our Postcard print and a good pair of headphones, and turn even the sweatiest subway car into your own personal vacation.

title: BRUNO JEAN YELLOW PAINTED OVER
desc: Painters’ pants not painterly enough? Our newest Bruno updates the classic straight-leg, mid-rise jean with lemony brush strokes, making it sure to please even the most literal-minded of dressers. (Though it should be noted, you’re not required to paint while wearing them. All are welcome in these jeans.) Bruno’s flattering fit and highly pairable print are made even more special with thoughtful details such as perfectly sturdy denim, complimentary front panels, and a nifty little loop for your brushes–or, if you’re really serious about this art thing, a rolled-up beret.

title: NIKKI SHORT POSTCARDS
desc: Embody your most crushed-upon summer camp counselor in Nikki, a perfect-weight denim short optimized for making out behind the archery range. An artfully frayed hemline shows off one’s gams, while a vision boards’ worth of vacation postcards brings new meaning to “sun’s out, buns out.” Slip over your favorite faded tee, or show your Parrot Head uncle who’s boss by pairing with the matching James top.

title: UMBRELLA SHELL SWEATER
desc: A delicately embroidered seaside retreat: like Do Not Disturb for your boobs! Let everyone know you’ve got a great rack and a rich inner world with our 100% cotton shell sweater, featuring a blissfully isolated beach umbrella against a sandy backdrop. Perfect for layering or wearing alone, for reading a book at the swim-up bar or stealing the resort manager’s golf cart–wherever the night takes you, you’re sure to look your best.

title: STAN SWEATER
desc: There are a lot of perks to welcoming Stan into your home. Stan will most likely not rack up wild vet bills. Stan can easily accompany you anywhere without proof of emotional support. Stan will absolutely not shit on your couch. Give Stan a home, won't you?

title: LIZZIE JACKET MARIE THE BAGUETTES
desc: Our chronically sold-out Marie the Baguettes print makes its sensational return in the Lizzie jacket. The perfect transitional piece is now covered in charcuterie with enough pockets for everyone's phones at the picnic.

title: MIKE PANT MARIE THE BAGUETTES
desc: Our chronically sold-out Marie the Baguettes print makes its bold return in the Mike Pant. Mike, your favorite throw and go, comfy pant has 1% stretch and will make you feel 100% gorgeous. Mike conveniently and beautifully pairs back to Lizzie.

title: SPLIT SLEEVELESS POLO STRAWBERRY PINK
desc: Remember summer at the country club cafe, with no parents and an open tab? Us neither, but we imagine that must be lovely! Consider the next best thing: a resort-ready polo tank sporting a vibrant, vaguely suggestive banana split. (The best kind!) In addition to a mouth-watering motif, this creamy strawberry knit features a thick ribbed hem and contrast striping at the sleeves and collar.

title: JAMES SHIRT BEER ME
desc: Our newest James shirt is practical not only for its perfect-width camp collar and handy front pocket, but because it does the talking for you: kitschy cocktails and gregarious chit-chat abound on this top, making it an easy conversation starter for those of us who need a few rounds to loosen up.

title: MIA DRESS CENTAUR TOILE
desc: Dappled with dazzling centaurs, our latest Mia is one of our most romantic styles to date–and that’s coming from the people who brought you an entire toile devoted to smut. Regal ‘n’ randy cryptids prance across a filmy cotton-voile maxi dress, complete with fluttery sleeves that deliquesce into a cape across the open back.

title: MINNIE DRESS POLKA DOT
desc: Minnie shares a name and a penchant for polka dots with a certain stylish rodent, but that’s where the similarities end: a curve-hugging fit, high hemline, and comely keyhole cutout at the bust make this dress decidedly PG-13. Pair Minnie with a svelte heel for an instantly cool going-out look, or wear with docs as a subtle nod to that episode of Daria where Jane dabbles in rockabilly.

title: HARPER DRESS RED TABLECLOTH
desc: We’ll say it: family barbecues lack sex appeal. Thanks to Harper, that’s about to change! A charming tablecloth print and tea-length hemline keep things family-friendly, while a structured bustier-inspired bodice reminds ‘em you’re only related by marriage. Dress Harper down with worn-in tennies and a straw clutch, or elevate with a delicate sandal for a posh picnic vibe.

title: LOLA DRESS ESPECIALLY THE BEANS
desc: Big Beanstalk strikes again: the magical fruit’s agenda to fill your wardrobe with beans is one step closer to completion with Lola, a wear-anywhere A-line mini dotted with our best-selling Especially the Beans print. Lola’s thigh-grazing hemline is balanced by a high neckline, and functional pockets fit up to 200 unsoaked garbanzos.

title: PIPPA SHELL SWEATER BLUE TABLECLOTH
desc: In honor of tricksy bears, tenacious ants, and booze poured into Stanley cups, we’ve lent our fan-favorite tablecloth print to a summery fitted shell sweater. Perfectly thick cotton covers what it needs to without smothering, while a cropped sleeveless silhouette keeps things cool. We recommend pairing Pippa with the matching Shannen skort and a room-temp egg salad sandwich.

title: SHANNEN SKORT BLUE TABLECLOTH
desc: Somersaulters rejoice! With a plush 100% cotton knit and built-in shorts, our brand-new Shannen skort beseeches you to get upside-down. A wraparound asymmetrical hemline and all-over picnic print with complimentary ribbed trim keep things fashionable while standing upright, too. Pair with the Pippa top for the best in both directions!

title: SYLVIE CUPCAKE MINI DRESS LIMEADE
desc: Love the freedom and power of a muumuu, but not ready to go full retirement community just yet? Sylvie’s the dress for you! With an easy A-line silhouette and plush terry construction, this mod mini is comfortable as the finest caftan. At the same time, a scalloped hem, pearly buttons, and icing-esque loopy trim ensure you’ll look about ten times more polished than you feel.

title: SYLVIE CUPCAKE MINI DRESS STRAWBERRY DAIQUIRI
desc: Like a hotter version of 1920s beachwear, Sylvie leaves just enough to the imagination: a scoop neck, tank sleeves, and scalloped hemline show off your best bits, while a soft A-line cut hides your belly button from Satan. Pair with a stacked sandal for a comfy going-out look, or with flats and a straw hat for a chic twist on the beach cover-up.

title: HARPER DRESS BLUE PAINTED OVER
desc: It’s a real shame only babies get dressed up like little sailors. We’re here to change that with Harper, a subtle nod to the nautical just begging to accompany you to the JC Penny photo studio. On this flowy midi dress, beachy blue strips are upgraded with contrast piping at the hem, bust, and straps. Pair with a jaunty sailor cap and prepare to get your cheeks pinched!

title: SID SKORT BEER ME
desc: With its A-line silhouette and flirty illusion skirt front, we thought Sid couldn’t get any more fun. Well, we thought wrong: this best-selling skort is now available covered in cocktails! Tropical drinks and their monikers bedeck a breezy cotton-linen blend, taking you from beach volleyball to wet t-shirt contest with ease.

title: SLOANE DRESS POLKA DOT
desc: Quaint and deceptively complex in its geometric starkness, there’s just something a bit femme fatale about the polka dot. The Sloane dress takes this siren-esque print even further with flattering flowy color-blocking, bold wide straps, and a square neckline that says “My wealthy husband suffered a tragic fall.” For maximum effect, pair with a pointy shoe, a plume of smoke, and a rakish P.I.

title: NIKKI SHORT SEASHELLS
desc: Finding a shell on the beach is a small delight, but it’s often served with a chaser of disappointment: that perfect scallop is actually a broken fragment; that sand dollar is technically still alive, and now you’re a murderer. Enter Nikki, a short that humbly offers all the wonder of a beachy discovery with none of the moral complexity. An uber-flattering high-cut leg, artfully frayed hem, and all-over shell print make Nikki perfect for beach bonfires, warm-weather dinner parties, and waiting for the return of your husband at sea.

title: LIBERATION x RACHEL ANTONOFF TEE
desc: CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED. UNANIMOUSLY LOVED. 100% cotton tee designed in collaboration with 'LIBERATION' on Broadway! Bess Wohl's LIBERATION runs on Broadway through February 1, 2026. Visit liberationbway.com for tickets and more info.

title: FALCO DRESS POLKA DOT
desc: Bored of your usual LBD? Us too. When designing Falco, we wanted a look that's at home in the boardroom and on the back of a motorcycle, a piece that says "I am sound of mind but free of spirit." In our humble opinion, this floaty mini delivers: a dreamy a-line shape is complimented by graphic peekaboo polka dots. While 100% silk and a timeless black-and-white colorway can be dressed up, down, or any which way you please.

title: CINDY DRESS POLKA DOT
desc: It's always a crapshoot whether a party will actually be fun, but you'll never doubt your outfit with our latest frock-a-fête. Statement-making without sacrificing comfort, Cindy's stretchy jersey bodice makes it easy to floor dance, table dance, and everything in between–while clouds of polka dot sateen ensure your ass will turn heads.

title: MIKE PANT JEWELS
desc: Instigate cute aggression among your peers with this unhingedly adorable assortment of tiny charms! Seashells, lockets, clovers and even a tiny Eiffel tower adorn our newest–and arguably most winsome–Mike pant. Mike's best-selling silhouette balances this sweet print with structured design details including a high waist, a wide leg, and extra large pockets.

title: MADDY DRESS MARTINI
desc: With its oversized cocktail intarsia and body-hugging fit, our latest Maddy dress is a nod to vintage decadence à la disco balls and dinners at Spago. This fan-favorite mini features a sleeveless silhouette and a thick-but-stretchy 100% cotton knit, plus a gleefully massive martini glass that screams "Meet me at the afters." Pair with a sheer tight and a platform penny loafer for a no-sweat dinner look, or with a tiny purse and your glitziest heels to outlast last call.

title: BUTTER PULLOVER
desc: Salted, whipped, melted, clarified: butter has range. In honor of everyone's favorite dairy product, we're delighted to bring you a sweater as versatile as its namesake. In addition to a bar of the good stuff, this pullover features a slightly fitted crewneck silhouette in a goes-with-anything royal blue knit, making it a sensible choice for walking the dog, milking the cow, or sowing your oats.

title: CORI CARDIGAN MINI MARTINI
desc: We can't in good faith recommend fifty martinis to you–but fifty tiny martinis? On your boobs? In the 1800s, that'd be prescription medicine! Our latest Cori is the cardigan you know and love– featuring a cropped fit, v-neck button-front, and ribbed collar and cuffs–plus an all-over mini martini print complete with olives and itty bitty cocktail frills. Wear Cori to zhuzh up your next lunch date, bring warmth to a slinky mini dress, or let the jury duty judge know you're just a little bit of a wild card.

title: MIKE PANT DOMINOES
desc: Mike's signature high waist and wide leg now comes with enough bones to satisfy a gaggle of grandpas on a summer stoop! Crafted in sturdy cotton, our newest Mike pant embodies the best of both the jean and slack worlds, while an all-over domino print brings a pop of interest to any snack run, gossip sesh, or court date. For girls' night or a dinner date, easily elevate the look with our sheer button-up Fleming top.

title: FLEMING SHIRT POLKA DOTS
desc: There are two types of people in the world: those who want to dress like Liza Minelli in Stepping Out, and liars. Embrace honesty and indulge your inner tap dancer in Fleming, a tip-top sheer shirt that razzles and dazzles with delicate silk georgette, a cheeky bib front, and polka-dot trim at the collar, placket, and cuffs. Cane and hat sold separately.

title: FALCO TENT DRESS RABBIT FLORAL
desc: For too long, the babydoll dress has been relegated to warmer seasons. With Falco, we say, no more! A wintery take on a floral frock that's perfect for layering and between-seasons dressing, this mini sports a floaty, oversized A-line silhouette and a warren of white rabbits for good luck.

title: MERYL TOP RABBIT FLORAL
desc: Pleats! Ruffles! Bell sleeves! Equal parts prissy and practical, Meryl is our very wearable ode to sartorial indulgence. Fashioned from luxe silk voile, this top's treasure trove of thoughtful details include a pintucked front, a delicate bow tie, and a garden of white blooms and bunnies. Tuck into a pencil skirt for a playful office look, or toss over jeans and be the talk of your next Watership Down LARP experience.

title: FLEMING SHIRT TREE OF LOST JEWELS
desc: Sexy butler or madame of the house? With Fleming, you never have to choose! On our newest button-up, a tangle of gilded braids and dazzling cabochons livens up a prim bib-front silhouette. Semi-sheer 100% silk georgette adds a hint of louche glamor to any look, while luxuriously long cuffs and a covered button panel will take you from office to diamond district to dinner with ease. To really put on the ritz, wear with the matching Bronwyn short.

title: LADY MINI DRESS MARIE THE BAGUETTES
desc: Be the sumptuous Dutch tableau you want to see in the world! In both cut and print, our newest fall mini is true romance: voluminous sheer sleeves, a plunging neckline, and a princess waist will have suitors jousting for your hand in no time, while all-over still-life delights scream "Paint me like one of your French cheeses."

title: LILITH DRESS BUTTS HERE
desc: Lilith boldly invites you to dress like your hair smells like cigarettes and your heart is full of joy. Named after an old testament rebel and 90s festival icon, this brand new silhouette sports a body-hugging fit, midi hemline, and sultry sheer mesh at the neck and sleeves. If that wasn't thrilling enough, sprawled across a deep teal textile you'll find cocktail napkins, cherries, poker chips, and more.

title: BRUNO JEAN RAILROAD RED STRIPE
desc: Choo-choo! Whether dressing with finesse or riding the Hot Mess Express, our Railroad Stripe print is a bold-yet-wearable take on your typical denim. We've updated Bruno's straight-leg painter's pant silhouette with an all-over red stripe pattern and contrast knee panels. BYO conductor hat and "rail me" one-liners!

title: GILLIAN MINI DRESS HOUNDSTOOTH
desc: Show leg while saving some neck for Jesus, in Gillian! Alternating houndstooth prints in graphic black and white give this swingy 60s-inspired mini all the spectacle of an ice dancer dress, sans falling on your ass. Pair with Docs and frilly socks for a look that's sweetly punk while still grown-up, or throw on a slingback heel for a low-effort, high-reward date night fit.

title: ACE OF HEARTS SKIRT
desc: Our Ace of Hearts skirt brings you the thrill of cancaning across a Parisian stage, in a fabric so comfy you'll actually want to cancan. A parade of upside-down hearts at the hem give this curve-hugging mini a dash of the unexpected, while its 100% cotton knit construction allows for the highest of kicks. For maximum impact, pair with the matching Molly pullover and a magnum of champagne.

title: MOLLY PULLOVER
desc: Whether you're a shark for poker, bridge, or old maid, the Molly top is a sure bet. Rendered in our signature thick cotton knit, this t-shirt silhouette boasts a comfy crew neck, heart-adorned sleeves, and a comely ace of hearts at the bust. Pair with worn-in jeans for your next ethical turtle racing event, or tuck into the Ace of Hearts skirt for a very cozy way to project wildcard energy.

title: CUPCAKE ROMPER
desc: If you love our Cupcake set but love fully disrobing to pee even more, we've got the piece for you! In our newest Unbasic Basic, the fan-favorite Cupcake cardigan-skort set melds into a sophisticated one-piece; sleek details like an asymmetrical hem and plunging ballerina neckline are elevated by scalloped trim and pearly buttons down the front. Pair with a svelte heel and scandalize your favorite public restroom in style!

title: CAVIAR SWEATER
desc: Not every sweater has "cuntiest heiress at the ski chalet" energy, and that's okay. For those of us who aspire to CHATSC, however, only our Caviar sweater will do. This 100% cotton fully-fashioned knit sports a thick ribbed hem, striped trim, and a larger-than-life caviar intarsia to put a Bond villain to shame.

title: PEGGY DRESS POLKA DOTS
desc: If we're going to sell you a little black dress, we know it has to stand out from the crowd. Enter Peggy: a one-and-done, slip-over-your-head shift silhouette made truly special with a tumble of polka dot ruffles reminiscent of '60s Barbie or your classiest aunt's closet. Structured-but-silky 100% faille offers an eye-catching hint of sheen, plus the ability to comfortably dance, brawl, and curl into a ball. Can your other LBDs say the same?

title: CUPCAKE SKORT RED
desc: Is nothing more effortlessly cool than a skort? Our cupcake skort offers femininity with a knowing wink (and by that we mean, you can spread all you want on the subway). Beyond the modesty panel, as we like to call it, the cupcake skort is a study in refined comfort: the knit scalloped skort is thick and just a bit stretchy, while the elastic rib waistband enables twisting, gyrating, and bicycle crunches. An asymmetrical hemline and delicate scalloped trim elevate the look, taking you from boardroom to ballroom to bar brawl. Pair with the matching Cupcake cardigan and evoke the energy of Straw

title: CAVIAR SKIRT
desc: Put the “tin” in flirting with the fanciest fish you’ll wear all season! The Caviar skirt is a high-hemline play on our best-selling caviar tin motif, featuring a curve-hugging mini silhouette trimmed with a Russian tea room’s worth of caviar tins. The 100% fully fashioned cotton knit is a perfect blend of stretchy and thick, making this piece an easy choice for dancing, dining, and butterfly crunches. We recommend pairing with the Caviar tank and a frosty shot of vodka.

title: CAVIAR TANK
desc: Love wearing caviar, hate it sticking in your belly button? We’ve got the top for you! More sartorially savvy and far less stinky than the real thing, our newest spring tank sports a larger-than-life caviar tin intarsia, a body-skimming fit, and chunky contrast piping along the straps and neckline. Tuck into high-waisted shorts for a breezy beach party look, or pair with the matching Caviar skirt for the ultimate in salt-packed sophistication.

title: MEADOW JOGGER SNAKES
desc: Missed out on those wildlife birthday parties as a kid? We’re here to heal that wound! Our Meadow jogger sports a slim-but-not-skinny silhouette, elastic cuffs at the ankle, and a reptile house’s worth of snakes on a 100% cotton navy background. (It’s kind of like they’re slithering through the night sky, which we think is beautiful.) Pair with the matching Helen crewneck and tennies for a statement-making lounge look.

title: SHERMAN PULLOVER
desc: Brussels Griffons: bearded, goblinesque, perfect. Humanity has its atrocities, but this breed ain’t one of ‘em. Honor these purse gargoyles in our newest pullover, which sports a nearly lifesize Griffon in booties–booties!--on a feather-soft navy alpaca blend knit.

title: MIKE PANT PASTA
desc: It’s been our mission since day one to cover your entire body in pasta; with our newest Mike, we’re one small step closer to that goal. An easy, eminently flattering high-rise silhouette features wide-cut legs and pockets that will actually hold an iPhone. (Seriously–why are pockets so small?) For the ultimate date night look, pair with the complimentary Lillian top and a g-string crafted from spaghetti.

title: GWEN DRESS PASTA
desc: Our newest Gwen bravely endeavors to satisfy your craving for bowties two ways! A Sunday supper’s worth of farfalle floats across inky printed taffeta–which, let’s be real, is the fun friend of fabrics–while silky ribbon bows dot each adjustable spaghetti strap. A body-skimming A-line fit and structured bust complete the look; simply add a ballet flat or a bitchy platform, and you’re on your way. Part nineties vixen, part nona’s kitchen, all-you-can-eat style!

title: LILLY DRESS CAVIAR
desc: Squishy, special, best enjoyed with a glass of champagne: we could be talking about caviar, we could be talking about your boobs. Why not celebrate both with our newest Lilly, a body-skimming party dress featuring silky mesh construction, sheer sleeves, and an oligarch’s pantry’s worth of caviar tins. Pair with an over-the-knee boot for effortless decadence, or with a gilded heel and a tiny purse to put the Mother in mother of pearl.

title: SCHMEAR SWEATER
desc: Schmear on one’s clothing is rarely a good thing, but we love to buck convention. Enter our newest fall sweater, which sports a larger-than-life, perfectly toasted bagel intarsia complete with cream cheese, lox, and tactile beaded poppy seeds. This burnt sienna fully-fashioned knit is lightweight enough to layer but warm enough for the movie theater, with plush ribbed trim and a flattering just-high-enough collar.

title: CUPCAKE CARDIGAN RED
desc: Cakey makeup? Bad. Cakey brownies? Depends on personal preference, but fudgey is a safer bet. Cakey cardigans? Ding ding ding! Our cupcake cardi is the most upscale homage to snacks around: this 100% cotton red collared cardigan sports a cropped fit and flattering rib trim at the sleeves and hem, while dainty scallop detailing and pearl buttons bring a sort of “loopy rich aunt” vibe. It’s the ultimate not-basic basic: add a little flair to a t-shirt and jeans, layer over a mini for a dose of chic comfort, or be the best dressed jet-setter in the matching Cupcake pant.

title: CUPCAKE PANT CAMEL
desc: Our legal team says we can’t claim we’ve made the most flattering and comfortable pants in existence, to which we say: okay, but have you tried them on? The cupcake pant is a 100% cotton dream with a soft-but-not-see-through knit, an uber-flattering slightly flared leg, and contrasting scalloped trim that takes any outfit to “going out” heights. Can your normal sweats claim as much? Pair with a strappy heel for a supremely easy date night look, or with the Cupcake Cardigan for a truly elegant take on the early 2000s tracksuit. title: BREAD AND BUTTER TANK
